records.key: Open Timelapse within Mask to segment and link objects across ordered frames; inspect links before downstream motility analysis.
records.source: Open Timelapse within Mask to segment and link objects across ordered frames; inspect links before downstream motility analysis.
records.translation: 마스크에서 타임랩스를 열어 순서가 있는 프레임에 걸쳐 객체를 분할하고 연결하세요. 하위 운동성 분석 전에 연결을 검사하세요.

records.key: Open a crop project in Annotate. Load test data provides an example. Choose the annotation column and label representative objects.
records.source: Open a crop project in Annotate. Load test data provides an example. Choose the annotation column and label representative objects.
records.translation: 어노테이션에서 크롭 프로젝트를 여세요. 테스트 데이터 불러오기로 예제를 받을 수 있습니다. 어노테이션 열을 선택하고 대표 객체에 레이블을 지정하세요.

records.key: Open a folder before running Object detection.
records.source: Open a folder before running Object detection.
records.translation: 객체 검출을 실행하기 전에 폴더를 여세요.

records.key: Open a module with a settings panel first — a template is a bundle of one module's settings.
records.source: Open a module with a settings panel first — a template is a bundle of one module's settings.
records.translation: 먼저 설정 패널이 있는 모듈을 여세요 — 템플릿은 한 모듈의 설정 묶음입니다.

records.key: Open a saved regression result and inspect effect sizes, adjusted significance and individual hit records.
records.source: Open a saved regression result and inspect effect sizes, adjusted significance and individual hit records.
records.translation: 저장된 회귀 결과를 열어 효과 크기, 보정된 유의성, 개별 히트 기록을 검사하세요.

records.key: Open the diagnostics actually written by this run.
records.source: Open the diagnostics actually written by this run.
records.translation: 이 실행이 실제로 기록한 진단 결과를 여세요.

records.key: Open the organism guide from Home to read the planned fungal imaging workflows and inspect the generic budding-yeast diagram. All eight assay tiles are Coming soon; none starts an analysis or produces a result.
records.source: Open the organism guide from Home to read the planned fungal imaging workflows and inspect the generic budding-yeast diagram. All eight assay tiles are Coming soon; none starts an analysis or produces a result.
records.translation: 홈에서 생물종 가이드를 열어 계획된 진균 이미징 워크플로를 읽고 일반적인 출아 효모 도식을 살펴보세요. 8개 어세이 타일은 모두 출시 예정이며, 어느 것도 분석을 시작하거나 결과를 생성하지 않습니다.

records.key: Open the organism guide from Home to read the planned malaria imaging workflows and inspect the shared apicomplexan diagram. All eight assay tiles are Coming soon; none starts an analysis or produces a result.
records.source: Open the organism guide from Home to read the planned malaria imaging workflows and inspect the shared apicomplexan diagram. All eight assay tiles are Coming soon; none starts an analysis or produces a result.
records.translation: 홈에서 생물종 가이드를 열어 계획된 말라리아 이미징 워크플로를 읽고 공통 정단복합체 도식을 살펴보세요. 8개 어세이 타일은 모두 출시 예정이며, 어느 것도 분석을 시작하거나 결과를 생성하지 않습니다.

records.key: Open the organism guide from Home, inspect the compartment diagram, then select Plaque Assay, Recruitment, Invasion Assay or Replication Assay. The four Coming soon tiles describe proposals and cannot run. The guide itself does not analyse a project or produce a measurement table.
records.source: Open the organism guide from Home, inspect the compartment diagram, then select Plaque Assay, Recruitment, Invasion Assay or Replication Assay. The four Coming soon tiles describe proposals and cannot run. The guide itself does not analyse a project or produce a measurement table.
records.translation: 홈에서 생물종 가이드를 열어 구획 도식을 살펴본 다음 Plaque Assay, 리크루트먼트, Invasion Assay 또는 Replication Assay를 선택하세요. 출시 예정 타일 4개는 제안을 설명하며 실행할 수 없습니다. 가이드 자체는 프로젝트를 분석하거나 측정 테이블을 생성하지 않습니다.

records.key: Opens GitHub's sign-up page in your browser. Come back here afterwards to install the GitHub CLI and sign in.
records.source: Opens GitHub's sign-up page in your browser. Come back here afterwards to install the GitHub CLI and sign in.
records.translation: 브라우저에서 GitHub 가입 페이지를 엽니다. 가입 후 여기로 돌아와 GitHub CLI를 설치하고 로그인하세요.

records.key: Optional steps applied to what the detector reads, in one fixed order. The image on disk is never changed.
records.source: Optional steps applied to what the detector reads, in one fixed order. The image on disk is never changed.
records.translation: 검출기가 읽는 이미지에 정해진 순서로 적용되는 선택적 단계입니다. 디스크의 이미지는 절대 바뀌지 않습니다.

records.key: Package recorded results, settings and QC into a shareable report without silently rerunning the analysis.
records.source: Package recorded results, settings and QC into a shareable report without silently rerunning the analysis.
records.translation: 분석을 몰래 다시 실행하지 않고 기록된 결과, 설정, QC를 공유 가능한 보고서로 묶으세요.

records.key: Page {page} of {pages} · crops {first}–{last} of {total}
records.source: Page {page} of {pages} · crops {first}–{last} of {total}
records.translation: 페이지 {page}/{pages} · 크롭 {first}–{last}/{total}

records.key: Pair guide counts with phenotype scores using consistent plate/well keys.
records.source: Pair guide counts with phenotype scores using consistent plate/well keys.
records.translation: 일관된 플레이트/웰 키를 사용해 가이드 개수와 표현형 점수를 짝지으세요.

records.key: Panel {letters} was read in {name}, but no legend is known for this figure. Paste the figure legend, or annotate by hand.
records.source: Panel {letters} was read in {name}, but no legend is known for this figure. Paste the figure legend, or annotate by hand.
records.translation: {letters} 패널을 {name}에서 읽었지만 이 그림의 범례를 알 수 없습니다. 그림 범례를 붙여 넣거나 직접 어노테이션하세요.

records.key: Pass the trained checkpoint as custom_model with the matching image channels and preprocessing.
records.source: Pass the trained checkpoint as custom_model with the matching image channels and preprocessing.
records.translation: 학습된 체크포인트를 일치하는 이미지 채널 및 전처리와 함께 custom_model 로 전달하세요.

records.key: Paste the figure legend, or annotate by hand
records.source: Paste the figure legend, or annotate by hand
records.translation: 그림 범례를 붙여 넣거나 직접 어노테이션하세요

records.key: Pixels above this are kept only where they connect to a seed above the strong level. Under 1.0 it is read as a fraction and becomes that percentile of the region (0.2 is the 20th); 1.0 and above is an absolute intensity.
records.source: Pixels above this are kept only where they connect to a seed above the strong level. Under 1.0 it is read as a fraction and becomes that percentile of the region (0.2 is the 20th); 1.0 and above is an absolute intensity.
records.translation: 이 값보다 높은 픽셀은 강한 수준을 넘는 시드에 연결된 경우에만 유지됩니다. 1.0 미만이면 비율로 읽어 영역의 해당 백분위수가 되며(0.2는 20번째 백분위수), 1.0 이상이면 절대 강도입니다.

records.key: Plaque mode reads cropped plaque images; Figure mode reads published figures. The settings below and the live preview follow this switch.
records.source: Plaque mode reads cropped plaque images; Figure mode reads published figures. The settings below and the live preview follow this switch.
records.translation: 플라크 모드는 잘라 낸 플라크 이미지를, 그림 모드는 게재된 그림을 읽습니다. 아래 설정과 실시간 미리보기는 이 스위치를 따릅니다.

records.key: Plaque mode: a folder of cropped plaque images. Every image is segmented, and the run writes a table of per-image values and a table of per-plaque values.
records.source: Plaque mode: a folder of cropped plaque images. Every image is segmented, and the run writes a table of per-image values and a table of per-plaque values.
records.translation: 플라크 모드: 잘라 낸 플라크 이미지 폴더. 모든 이미지를 분할하고, 실행은 이미지별 값 테이블과 플라크별 값 테이블을 씁니다.

records.key: Plasmodium parasites cause malaria. Their life cycle includes mosquito and vertebrate hosts, with liver and blood stages in humans. Microscopy distinguishes parasite forms in infected red blood cells. Image-based studies can measure infection frequency, stage progression, motility and responses to compounds.
records.source: Plasmodium parasites cause malaria. Their life cycle includes mosquito and vertebrate hosts, with liver and blood stages in humans. Microscopy distinguishes parasite forms in infected red blood cells. Image-based studies can measure infection frequency, stage progression, motility and responses to compounds.
records.translation: Plasmodium 기생충은 말라리아를 일으킵니다. 생활사에는 모기와 척추동물 숙주가 포함되며, 사람에서는 간 단계와 혈액 단계를 거칩니다. 현미경으로 감염된 적혈구 안의 기생충 형태를 구별할 수 있습니다. 이미지 기반 연구로 감염 빈도, 단계 진행, 운동성, 화합물에 대한 반응을 측정할 수 있습니다.

records.key: Play a few seconds of the music bed at the volume above.
records.source: Play a few seconds of the music bed at the volume above.
records.translation: 위의 음량으로 배경 음악을 몇 초간 재생합니다.

records.key: Play this sound once at the volume above.
records.source: Play this sound once at the volume above.
records.translation: 위의 음량으로 이 소리를 한 번 재생합니다.

records.key: Plot selected measurement columns with object-crop inspection.
records.source: Plot selected measurement columns with object-crop inspection.
records.translation: 객체 크롭 검사와 함께 선택한 측정 열을 그래프로 그리세요.

records.key: Press Re-apply to sort the files with this pattern.
records.source: Press Re-apply to sort the files with this pattern.
records.translation: 이 패턴으로 파일을 정렬하려면 다시 적용을 누르세요.

records.key: Project run records, settings, output paths, artifact provenance, status and logs.
records.source: Project run records, settings, output paths, artifact provenance, status and logs.
records.translation: 프로젝트 실행 기록, 설정, 출력 경로, 산출물 출처, 상태 및 로그.

records.key: Provide the saved label TIFFs and their original images to External Masks, assign object roles and create the merged project before Measure.
records.source: Provide the saved label TIFFs and their original images to External Masks, assign object roles and create the merged project before Measure.
records.translation: 저장된 레이블 TIFFs와 원본 이미지를 External Masks에 제공하고, 객체 역할을 할당한 다음 측정 전에 병합 프로젝트를 만드세요.

records.key: Pseudo wells from condition/folder column
records.source: Pseudo wells from condition/folder column
records.translation: 조건/폴더 열에서 만든 가상 웰

records.key: Python settings dictionary: iterable sweep values for screen size, occupancy, classifier accuracy and sequencing assumptions, plus replicates, src, name, variable, plot and max_workers. generate_parameters expands their Cartesian product; begin with a small sweep and an explicit worker bound.
records.source: Python settings dictionary: iterable sweep values for screen size, occupancy, classifier accuracy and sequencing assumptions, plus replicates, src, name, variable, plot and max_workers. generate_parameters expands their Cartesian product; begin with a small sweep and an explicit worker bound.
records.translation: Python 설정 사전: 스크린 크기, 점유율, 분류기 정확도, 시퀀싱 가정에 대한 반복 가능한 스윕 값과 함께 replicates, src, name, variable, plot, max_workers. generate_parameters가 이들의 데카르트 곱을 전개합니다. 작은 스윕과 명시적인 워커 수 한도로 시작하세요.

records.key: Rank measured features for a chosen class comparison; review filtering and class definitions before interpreting the ranking.
records.source: Rank measured features for a chosen class comparison; review filtering and class definitions before interpreting the ranking.
records.translation: 선택한 클래스 비교에 대해 측정된 특징의 순위를 매기세요. 순위를 해석하기 전에 필터링과 클래스 정의를 검토하세요.

records.key: Re-measure only when needed; External Masks can already perform measurement.
records.source: Re-measure only when needed; External Masks can already perform measurement.
records.translation: 필요할 때만 다시 측정하세요. External Masks도 이미 측정을 수행할 수 있습니다.

records.key: Read measured compartment areas, annotate conditions and bin area ** 1.5 into log2 size doublings. Defaults aggregate pathogen area per host cell, not per vacuole: multiple vacuoles in one cell are combined. This is an area-derived size proxy, not measured volume or a parasite count. Use Replication Assay with explicit vacuole identity for parasites-per-vacuole counts. Configure compartment, area filters, calibration, conditions and grouping before calling the API; saving is optional.
records.source: Read measured compartment areas, annotate conditions and bin area ** 1.5 into log2 size doublings. Defaults aggregate pathogen area per host cell, not per vacuole: multiple vacuoles in one cell are combined. This is an area-derived size proxy, not measured volume or a parasite count. Use Replication Assay with explicit vacuole identity for parasites-per-vacuole counts. Configure compartment, area filters, calibration, conditions and grouping before calling the API; saving is optional.
records.translation: 측정된 구획 면적을 읽고, 조건을 어노테이션하며, area ** 1.5를 log2 크기 배가 구간으로 나눕니다. 기본값은 공포가 아니라 숙주 세포별로 병원체 면적을 집계하므로 한 세포 안의 여러 공포가 합쳐집니다. 이는 면적 기반 크기 대리 지표이며, 측정된 부피나 기생충 수가 아닙니다. 공포당 기생충 수가 필요하면 명시적인 공포 식별 정보와 함께 Replication Assay를 사용하세요. API를 호출하기 전에 구획, 면적 필터, 보정, 조건, 그룹화를 설정하세요. 저장은 선택 사항입니다.

records.key: Read recorded artifact dependencies and stale/missing status. The graph describes provenance and does not regenerate missing artifacts.
records.source: Read recorded artifact dependencies and stale/missing status. The graph describes provenance and does not regenerate missing artifacts.
records.translation: 기록된 산출물 의존 관계와 오래됨/누락 상태를 읽습니다. 그래프는 출처를 설명할 뿐, 누락된 산출물을 다시 생성하지 않습니다.

records.key: Reading crops for montage {number} of {total}…
records.source: Reading crops for montage {number} of {total}…
records.translation: 몽타주 {number}/{total}의 크롭을 읽는 중…

records.key: Reading database {number} of {total}: {name}
records.source: Reading database {number} of {total}: {name}
records.translation: 데이터베이스 {number}/{total} 읽는 중: {name}

records.key: Reject every suggestion on this page you have not judged yet. Undoable with U.
records.source: Reject every suggestion on this page you have not judged yet. Undoable with U.
records.translation: 이 페이지에서 아직 판정하지 않은 모든 제안을 거부합니다. U로 실행 취소할 수 있습니다.

records.key: Remove every object from this field. It asks first, and it is one undo step, so a press by accident costs one Ctrl+Z.
records.source: Remove every object from this field. It asks first, and it is one undo step, so a press by accident costs one Ctrl+Z.
records.translation: 이 시야의 모든 객체를 제거합니다. 먼저 확인을 요청하며 실행 취소 한 단계이므로, 실수로 눌러도 Ctrl+Z 한 번이면 됩니다.

records.key: Replication Assay counts parasites per vacuole, providing a readout of intracellular growth at the sampled time. Plaque Assay measures cleared areas across a host-cell monolayer and therefore integrates multiple rounds of infection and growth. A smaller plaque can reflect more than one defect: compare the plaque result with invasion and replication measurements before assigning it to a particular step.
records.source: Replication Assay counts parasites per vacuole, providing a readout of intracellular growth at the sampled time. Plaque Assay measures cleared areas across a host-cell monolayer and therefore integrates multiple rounds of infection and growth. A smaller plaque can reflect more than one defect: compare the plaque result with invasion and replication measurements before assigning it to a particular step.
records.translation: Replication Assay는 공포당 기생충을 세어 채취 시점의 세포내 증식 판독값을 제공합니다. Plaque Assay는 숙주 세포 단층에서 제거된 영역을 측정하므로 여러 차례의 감염과 증식을 통합합니다. 플라크가 작다는 것은 둘 이상의 결함을 반영할 수 있습니다. 특정 단계의 문제로 판단하기 전에 플라크 결과를 침입 및 증식 측정값과 비교하세요.

records.key: Require explicit parasite-to-vacuole identities.
records.source: Require explicit parasite-to-vacuole identities.
records.translation: 명시적인 기생충-공포 식별 정보가 필요합니다.

records.key: Require the intended compartment intensities and identities.
records.source: Require the intended compartment intensities and identities.
records.translation: 의도한 구획 강도와 식별 정보가 필요합니다.

records.key: Require two-colour stain measurements and appropriate baseline controls.
records.source: Require two-colour stain measurements and appropriate baseline controls.
records.translation: 2색 염색 측정값과 적절한 기준 대조군이 필요합니다.

records.key: Resolving crop paths for database {number} of {total} ({rows} objects)…
records.source: Resolving crop paths for database {number} of {total} ({rows} objects)…
records.translation: 데이터베이스 {number}/{total}의 크롭 경로를 확인하는 중(객체 {rows}개)…

records.key: Resting the pointer on a button, a field or a column header for two seconds shows a small label saying what it is. The label stays while the pointer is on it and leaves a second after the pointer goes. Cleared, no tooltip appears anywhere in spaCR.
records.source: Resting the pointer on a button, a field or a column header for two seconds shows a small label saying what it is. The label stays while the pointer is on it and leaves a second after the pointer goes. Cleared, no tooltip appears anywhere in spaCR.
records.translation: 버튼, 입력란 또는 열 머리글에 포인터를 2초간 올려 두면 무엇인지 알려 주는 작은 레이블이 표시됩니다. 레이블은 포인터가 그 위에 있는 동안 유지되고, 포인터가 벗어나면 1초 뒤 사라집니다. 체크를 해제하면 spaCR 어디에서도 툴팁이 나타나지 않습니다.

records.key: Restoration ready: {model} on {device}; original intensities retained for measurements.
records.source: Restoration ready: {model} on {device}; original intensities retained for measurements.
records.translation: 복원 준비 완료: {model}({device}에서 실행). 측정에는 원래 강도를 유지합니다.

records.key: Retain encoder and channel-policy provenance.
records.source: Retain encoder and channel-policy provenance.
records.translation: 인코더와 채널 정책 출처 정보를 보존하세요.

records.key: Returned data and chi_squared DataFrames; save=True also writes data.csv, chi_squared_results.csv, chi_squared_pairwise_results.csv and a figure under the first project root/results/analyze_endodyogeny/.
records.source: Returned data and chi_squared DataFrames; save=True also writes data.csv, chi_squared_results.csv, chi_squared_pairwise_results.csv and a figure under the first project root/results/analyze_endodyogeny/.
records.translation: 반환되는 data 및 chi_squared DataFrames. save=True이면 첫 번째 프로젝트 루트/results/analyze_endodyogeny/ 아래에 data.csv, chi_squared_results.csv, chi_squared_pairwise_results.csv 파일과 그림도 씁니다.

records.key: Review available checks and missing evidence.
records.source: Review available checks and missing evidence.
records.translation: 사용 가능한 검사와 누락된 근거를 검토하세요.

records.key: Review exported prose and every traced result.
records.source: Review exported prose and every traced result.
records.translation: 내보낸 문장과 추적된 모든 결과를 검토하세요.

records.key: Review field identities, image channels and optional external masks before writing a separate project. Image-only imports still need segmentation before measurement.
records.source: Review field identities, image channels and optional external masks before writing a separate project. Image-only imports still need segmentation before measurement.
records.translation: 별도 프로젝트를 쓰기 전에 시야 식별 정보, 이미지 채널, 선택적 외부 마스크를 검토하세요. 이미지만 가져온 경우 측정 전에 분할이 필요합니다.

records.key: Review robust object/well outlier scores and the selected exclusion rule before carrying filtered data into analysis.
records.source: Review robust object/well outlier scores and the selected exclusion rule before carrying filtered data into analysis.
records.translation: 필터링된 데이터를 분석에 넘기기 전에 강건한 객체/웰 이상치 점수와 선택된 제외 규칙을 검토하세요.

records.key: Right canvas: outline overlay · label masks · Cellpose flows · cell probability
records.source: Right canvas: outline overlay · label masks · Cellpose flows · cell probability
records.translation: 오른쪽 캔버스: 윤곽선 오버레이 · 레이블 마스크 · Cellpose 흐름 · 세포 확률

records.key: Rows are fields, columns are channels and mask types. Drop files anywhere on this table, or double-click a cell to browse for the one file it wants.
records.source: Rows are fields, columns are channels and mask types. Drop files anywhere on this table, or double-click a cell to browse for the one file it wants.
records.translation: 행은 시야, 열은 채널과 마스크 유형입니다. 이 표 어디에나 파일을 드롭하거나, 칸을 더블클릭하여 필요한 파일 하나를 찾아보세요.

records.key:
Run Object detection to see the cell-probability map
and the flow field for this field.
records.source:
Run Object detection to see the cell-probability map
and the flow field for this field.
records.translation:
이 시야의 세포 확률 맵과 흐름 필드를 보려면
객체 검출을 실행하세요.

records.key: Run a stock or custom Cellpose model on TIFF fields through the Python API. Despite its historical identify_masks_finetune name, this function performs inference, not training. Review normalization, channels, resizing and model parameters; masks are written only when save is enabled. Import compatible image/mask pairs through External Masks before Measure, or curate the pairs before training. This call does not build a Measure-ready merged project.
records.source: Run a stock or custom Cellpose model on TIFF fields through the Python API. Despite its historical identify_masks_finetune name, this function performs inference, not training. Review normalization, channels, resizing and model parameters; masks are written only when save is enabled. Import compatible image/mask pairs through External Masks before Measure, or curate the pairs before training. This call does not build a Measure-ready merged project.
records.translation: Python API를 통해 TIFF 시야에 기본 또는 사용자 지정 Cellpose 모델을 실행합니다. identify_masks_finetune 이라는 과거 이름과 달리 이 함수는 학습이 아니라 추론을 수행합니다. 정규화, 채널, 크기 조정, 모델 매개변수를 검토하세요. 마스크는 save가 켜져 있을 때만 기록됩니다. 측정 전에 External Masks를 통해 호환되는 이미지/마스크 쌍을 가져오거나, 학습 전에 쌍을 선별하세요. 이 호출은 측정에 바로 쓸 수 있는 병합 프로젝트를 만들지 않습니다.

records.key: Run explicitly selected regression settings and compare their diagnostics. Keep the input data and evaluation question fixed.
records.source: Run explicitly selected regression settings and compare their diagnostics. Keep the input data and evaluation question fixed.
records.translation: 명시적으로 선택한 회귀 설정을 실행하고 진단 결과를 비교하세요. 입력 데이터와 평가 질문은 고정하세요.

records.key: Run the CPU method chosen under Detection method on the whole image and label what it finds, honouring the minimum area above. Everything the method reads is that category: the level's algorithm, the correction, the smoothing, which side is the object, filling holes, splitting a pair that touches and dropping what the frame cut. With Cellpose or a backend chosen this button falls back to Otsu, because those have the Object detection button of their own.
records.source: Run the CPU method chosen under Detection method on the whole image and label what it finds, honouring the minimum area above. Everything the method reads is that category: the level's algorithm, the correction, the smoothing, which side is the object, filling holes, splitting a pair that touches and dropping what the frame cut. With Cellpose or a backend chosen this button falls back to Otsu, because those have the Object detection button of their own.
records.translation: 검출 방법에서 선택한 CPU 방법을 이미지 전체에 실행하고, 위의 최소 면적을 지키며 찾은 것에 레이블을 지정합니다. 방법이 읽는 모든 항목은 그 범주의 설정입니다: 수준 알고리즘, 보정, 평활화, 어느 쪽이 객체인지, 구멍 채우기, 맞닿은 쌍 분할, 프레임에 잘린 객체 제외. Cellpose나 백엔드를 선택한 경우 이 버튼은 Otsu로 대체됩니다. 그것들에는 자체 객체 검출 버튼이 있기 때문입니다.

records.key: Run the chosen pipeline across plates. Outputs are those of each queued module; retain each plate and its settings separately.
records.source: Run the chosen pipeline across plates. Outputs are those of each queued module; retain each plate and its settings separately.
records.translation: 선택한 파이프라인을 여러 플레이트에 걸쳐 실행하세요. 출력은 대기열에 넣은 각 모듈의 출력이며, 각 플레이트와 그 설정을 따로 보존하세요.

records.key: Save or stream crops with stable object identities.
records.source: Save or stream crops with stable object identities.
records.translation: 안정적인 객체 식별자와 함께 크롭을 저장하거나 스트리밍하세요.

records.key: Save the picture as it is drawn here, at its full size: the outlines and well boxes keep the line weights and colours chosen for them.
records.source: Save the picture as it is drawn here, at its full size: the outlines and well boxes keep the line weights and colours chosen for them.
records.translation: 여기 그려진 그대로 전체 크기로 그림을 저장합니다. 윤곽선과 웰 상자는 지정한 선 굵기와 색을 유지합니다.

records.key: Saved Cellpose-compatible checkpoint or a compatible installed backend selected with its own configuration.
records.source: Saved Cellpose-compatible checkpoint or a compatible installed backend selected with its own configuration.
records.translation: 저장된 Cellpose 호환 체크포인트 또는 자체 구성으로 선택한 호환 설치 백엔드.

records.key: Saved classifier checkpoint, model settings and matching channel/preprocessing configuration.
records.source: Saved classifier checkpoint, model settings and matching channel/preprocessing configuration.
records.translation: 저장된 분류기 체크포인트, 모델 설정 및 일치하는 채널/전처리 구성.

records.key: Saved model-response/saliency images for the matching classifier and input preprocessing.
records.source: Saved model-response/saliency images for the matching classifier and input preprocessing.
records.translation: 일치하는 분류기와 입력 전처리에 대한 저장된 모델 반응/돌출도 이미지.

records.key: Saved module/plate/settings job definitions and dependency order.
records.source: Saved module/plate/settings job definitions and dependency order.
records.translation: 저장된 모듈/플레이트/설정 작업 정의와 의존 순서.

records.key: Saved planning tables or figures based on explicitly chosen effect sizes, variability and sampling assumptions.
records.source: Saved planning tables or figures based on explicitly chosen effect sizes, variability and sampling assumptions.
records.translation: 명시적으로 선택한 효과 크기, 변동성, 샘플링 가정에 기반한 저장된 계획 테이블 또는 그림.

records.key: Saved score CSVs and, when merged, measurements/measurements.db, table png_list.
records.source: Saved score CSVs and, when merged, measurements/measurements.db, table png_list.
records.translation: 저장된 점수 CSVs와, 병합한 경우 png_list 테이블(measurements/measurements.db).

records.key: Saved threshold/polygon gate definitions or a selected object set; apply a gate to the same feature definitions.
records.source: Saved threshold/polygon gate definitions or a selected object set; apply a gate to the same feature definitions.
records.translation: 저장된 임계값/다각형 게이트 정의 또는 선택된 객체 집합. 게이트는 같은 특징 정의에 적용하세요.

records.key: Scale this preview's controls, text and pictures, from 10 % to 200 %, without changing the rest of spaCR. It applies straight away and is remembered for this preview. Double-click the percentage to go back to 100 %; Ctrl+Alt+0 resets every scale.
records.source: Scale this preview's controls, text and pictures, from 10 % to 200 %, without changing the rest of spaCR. It applies straight away and is remembered for this preview. Double-click the percentage to go back to 100 %; Ctrl+Alt+0 resets every scale.
records.translation: spaCR의 나머지 부분은 바꾸지 않고 이 미리보기의 컨트롤, 텍스트, 그림 크기를 10 %에서 200 %까지 조정합니다. 즉시 적용되며 이 미리보기에 대해 기억됩니다. 백분율을 더블클릭하면 100 %로 돌아가고, Ctrl+Alt+0은 모든 배율을 초기화합니다.

records.key: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan. Both pictures move together.
records.source: Scroll to zoom, drag to pan. Both pictures move together.
records.translation: 스크롤하면 확대/축소, 끌면 이동합니다. 두 그림이 함께 움직입니다.

records.key: Select CV predictions and the matching measured objects.
records.source: Select CV predictions and the matching measured objects.
records.translation: CV 예측과 일치하는 측정 객체를 선택하세요.

records.key: Select a project with merged images and masks. Load test data provides an example. Check the image and label channels before measuring.
records.source: Select a project with merged images and masks. Load test data provides an example. Check the image and label channels before measuring.
records.translation: 병합된 이미지와 마스크가 있는 프로젝트를 선택하세요. 테스트 데이터 불러오기로 예제를 받을 수 있습니다. 측정하기 전에 이미지 채널과 레이블 채널을 확인하세요.

records.key: Select channels and models, inspect a preview, then run Mask. Measure consumes the merged arrays; the counts database is not yet a feature table.
records.source: Select channels and models, inspect a preview, then run Mask. Measure consumes the merged arrays; the counts database is not yet a feature table.
records.translation: 채널과 모델을 선택하고 미리보기를 검사한 다음 마스크를 실행하세요. 측정은 병합 배열을 사용하며, 개수 데이터베이스는 아직 특징 테이블이 아닙니다.

records.key: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity.
records.source: Select the intended CV or ML score column and preserve plate/well identity.
records.translation: 의도한 CV 또는 ML 점수 열을 선택하고 플레이트/웰 식별 정보를 보존하세요.

records.key: Select the saved compatible checkpoint in Mask.
records.source: Select the saved compatible checkpoint in Mask.
records.translation: 마스크에서 저장된 호환 체크포인트를 선택하세요.

records.key: Select your FASTQ files and matching barcode references. Load test data provides an example. Check the column, row and guide references before mapping.
records.source: Select your FASTQ files and matching barcode references. Load test data provides an example. Check the column, row and guide references before mapping.
records.translation: FASTQ 파일과 일치하는 바코드 참조를 선택하세요. 테스트 데이터 불러오기로 예제를 받을 수 있습니다. 매핑 전에 열, 행, 가이드 참조를 확인하세요.

records.key: Selected run results folder: coefficient/result CSVs, hit tables, settings and diagnostic figures.
records.source: Selected run results folder: coefficient/result CSVs, hit tables, settings and diagnostic figures.
records.translation: 선택한 실행 결과 폴더: 계수/결과 CSVs, 히트 테이블, 설정 및 진단 그림.

records.key: Send the matching image/labels to napari and import the revised labels back with field identity preserved.
records.source: Send the matching image/labels to napari and import the revised labels back with field identity preserved.
records.translation: 일치하는 이미지/레이블을 napari로 보내고, 시야 식별 정보를 보존한 채 수정된 레이블을 다시 가져오세요.

records.key: Separate image and integer-mask files with matching field identities; preserve original images and labels.
records.source: Separate image and integer-mask files with matching field identities; preserve original images and labels.
records.translation: 시야 식별 정보가 일치하는 이미지 파일과 정수 마스크 파일을 분리하세요. 원본 이미지와 레이블을 보존하세요.

records.key:
Share this model so other spaCR users can download it?

다른 spaCR 사용자가 다운로드할 수 있도록 이 모델을 공유할까요?

성적표에 들어갈 숫자를 입력하라는 요청을 받게 됩니다. 모델은 공유 spaCR 컬렉션에 업로드되며, 모델 저장소에 표시되기 전에 검토를 위해 보류됩니다 -- Hugging Face 계정은 필요하지 않습니다.

records.key: Showing the enhanced image the detector reads.
records.source: Showing the enhanced image the detector reads.
records.translation: 검출기가 읽는 향상된 이미지를 표시합니다.

records.key: Showing the first 50 measured fields; choose a narrower source for other fields.
records.source: Showing the first 50 measured fields; choose a narrower source for other fields.
records.translation: 측정된 시야 중 처음 50개를 표시합니다. 다른 시야를 보려면 더 좁은 소스를 선택하세요.

records.key: Showing the image inverted — dark is bright — and detecting on it. The hover intensity follows the picture and says so; filtering, the object mean and saving still use the original pixels.
records.source: Showing the image inverted — dark is bright — and detecting on it. The hover intensity follows the picture and says so; filtering, the object mean and saving still use the original pixels.
records.translation: 이미지를 반전하여 — 어두운 곳이 밝게 — 표시하고 그 위에서 검출합니다. 마우스 오버 강도는 그림을 따르며 그렇다고 표시합니다. 필터링, 객체 평균, 저장은 여전히 원래 픽셀을 사용합니다.

records.key: Sign in to {label} in the window that opened. spaCR notices when you are done.
records.source: Sign in to {label} in the window that opened. spaCR notices when you are done.
records.translation: 열린 창에서 {label}에 로그인하세요. 완료되면 spaCR이 알아차립니다.

records.key: Signing in to {label} did not finish within {minutes} minutes. Press Sign in to try again.
records.source: Signing in to {label} did not finish within {minutes} minutes. Press Sign in to try again.
records.translation: {label} 로그인이 {minutes}분 안에 끝나지 않았습니다. 다시 시도하려면 로그인을 누르세요.

records.key: Single-end or paired FASTQ files, with the matching barcode reference tables.
records.source: Single-end or paired FASTQ files, with the matching barcode reference tables.
records.translation: 싱글 엔드 또는 페어드 FASTQ 파일과 일치하는 바코드 참조 테이블.

records.key: Smooth the noise before the contrast step amplifies it. Gaussian is a blur and softens edges with the noise; Median removes speckle and keeps edges; Bilateral and Non-local means keep edges better still and are much slower. HEAVY: non-local means is minutes on a whole 2,000 px field, and seconds on a magnifier box.
records.source: Smooth the noise before the contrast step amplifies it. Gaussian is a blur and softens edges with the noise; Median removes speckle and keeps edges; Bilateral and Non-local means keep edges better still and are much slower. HEAVY: non-local means is minutes on a whole 2,000 px field, and seconds on a magnifier box.
records.translation: 대비 단계가 잡음을 증폭하기 전에 잡음을 평활화합니다. 가우스는 블러로 잡음과 함께 가장자리도 흐리게 하고, 중앙값은 반점 잡음을 없애면서 가장자리를 유지하며, 양방향 필터와 비국소 평균은 가장자리를 더 잘 유지하지만 훨씬 느립니다. 무거운 작업(HEAVY): 비국소 평균은 2,000 px 시야 전체에 수 분, 돋보기 상자에 수 초가 걸립니다.

records.key: Sort every file this table already holds again, with the regex as it reads now.
records.source: Sort every file this table already holds again, with the regex as it reads now.
records.translation: 이 표에 이미 있는 모든 파일을 현재의 정규식으로 다시 정렬합니다.

records.key: Source image folder; original files, supported vendor files or imported TIFFs.
records.source: Source image folder; original files, supported vendor files or imported TIFFs.
records.translation: 원본 이미지 폴더: 원본 파일, 지원되는 제조사 파일 또는 가져온 TIFFs.

records.key: Spin about {axis} only: a drag turns the volume about that measurement's axis and leaves it where it is on screen.
records.source: Spin about {axis} only: a drag turns the volume about that measurement's axis and leaves it where it is on screen.
records.translation: {axis} 축으로만 회전: 끌면 볼륨이 해당 측정값의 축을 중심으로 돌며, 보이는 위치는 그대로 유지됩니다.

records.key: Starplast {installed} is installed. Version {latest} is available on PyPI. Upgrade through pip before opening?
records.source: Starplast {installed} is installed. Version {latest} is available on PyPI. Upgrade through pip before opening?
records.translation: Starplast {installed}이(가) 설치되어 있습니다. PyPI에 버전 {latest}이(가) 있습니다. 열기 전에 pip으로 업그레이드할까요?

records.key: Start with an image project. Use Load test data within Mask for an example, or select your image folder. Check the channel assignments before running.
records.source: Start with an image project. Use Load test data within Mask for an example, or select your image folder. Check the channel assignments before running.
records.translation: 이미지 프로젝트로 시작하세요. 예제가 필요하면 마스크의 테스트 데이터 불러오기를 사용하거나 이미지 폴더를 선택하세요. 실행 전에 채널 할당을 확인하세요.

records.key: Stop this montage and queued selections after the current read finishes.
records.source: Stop this montage and queued selections after the current read finishes.
records.translation: 현재 읽기가 끝난 뒤 이 몽타주와 대기 중인 선택을 중지합니다.

records.key: Stopped waiting for the sign-in. Press Sign in to start it again, or Done once you have signed in.
records.source: Stopped waiting for the sign-in. Press Sign in to start it again, or Done once you have signed in.
records.translation: 로그인 대기를 중지했습니다. 다시 시작하려면 로그인을 누르고, 로그인을 마쳤으면 완료를 누르세요.

records.key: Stored project checks and QC reports; a missing check is not a passing result.
records.source: Stored project checks and QC reports; a missing check is not a passing result.
records.translation: 저장된 프로젝트 검사와 QC 보고서. 누락된 검사는 통과 결과가 아닙니다.

records.key: Submit a configured run to a remote execution target and inspect its status and logs. Retrieve the actual module artifacts before downstream analysis.
records.source: Submit a configured run to a remote execution target and inspect its status and logs. Retrieve the actual module artifacts before downstream analysis.
records.translation: 설정된 실행을 원격 실행 대상에 제출하고 상태와 로그를 검사하세요. 하위 분석 전에 실제 모듈 산출물을 가져오세요.

records.key: Subtract the slowly varying background before anything else. Rolling ball fits a surface of the radius below and takes it away, which is what flattens uneven illumination; Top-hat keeps only what is brighter than its surroundings within that radius and is much faster. Set the radius comfortably LARGER than the largest object: a radius under the object size eats the objects with the background. The background is ESTIMATED on a smaller copy, at the scale below, because a background is by definition what varies slowly across the field and so is the one thing that survives being looked at smaller.
records.source: Subtract the slowly varying background before anything else. Rolling ball fits a surface of the radius below and takes it away, which is what flattens uneven illumination; Top-hat keeps only what is brighter than its surroundings within that radius and is much faster. Set the radius comfortably LARGER than the largest object: a radius under the object size eats the objects with the background. The background is ESTIMATED on a smaller copy, at the scale below, because a background is by definition what varies slowly across the field and so is the one thing that survives being looked at smaller.
records.translation: 다른 어떤 단계보다 먼저 천천히 변하는 배경을 뺍니다. 롤링 볼은 아래 반지름의 표면을 맞춰 제거하여 고르지 않은 조명을 평탄화하고, 톱햇은 그 반지름 안에서 주변보다 밝은 것만 남기며 훨씬 빠릅니다. 반지름은 가장 큰 객체보다 넉넉히 크게(LARGER) 설정하세요. 반지름이 객체 크기보다 작으면 배경과 함께 객체도 지워집니다. 배경은 아래 스케일의 더 작은 사본에서 추정(ESTIMATED)합니다. 배경은 정의상 시야 전체에서 천천히 변하는 것이므로 작게 보아도 유지되는 유일한 요소이기 때문입니다.

records.key: Suggested crops wear a ? badge. Click one or press Y to confirm it; right-click or press N to reject it; U undoes.
records.source: Suggested crops wear a ? badge. Click one or press Y to confirm it; right-click or press N to reject it; U undoes.
records.translation: 제안된 크롭에는 ? 배지가 붙습니다. 확인하려면 클릭하거나 Y를, 거부하려면 오른쪽 클릭하거나 N을 누르세요. U는 실행 취소입니다.

records.key: Suits a field split near half and half. The level is the mean intensity, which is as crude as it sounds and is here as a baseline to judge the others against.
records.source: Suits a field split near half and half. The level is the mean intensity, which is as crude as it sounds and is here as a baseline to judge the others against.
records.translation: 시야가 절반 정도로 나뉠 때 적합합니다. 수준은 평균 강도로, 말 그대로 조잡한 방법이며 다른 방법을 판단하는 기준선으로 제공됩니다.

records.key: Suits a field whose objects are a small, bright minority -- Li minimises the cross entropy between the field and its thresholded self rather than assuming two equal populations, so it holds up where Otsu drifts into the background.
records.source: Suits a field whose objects are a small, bright minority -- Li minimises the cross entropy between the field and its thresholded self rather than assuming two equal populations, so it holds up where Otsu drifts into the background.
records.translation: 객체가 작고 밝은 소수인 시야에 적합합니다. Li는 두 집단의 크기가 같다고 가정하지 않고 시야와 임계값을 적용한 시야 사이의 교차 엔트로피를 최소화하므로, Otsu가 배경 쪽으로 밀리는 경우에도 잘 버팁니다.

records.key: Suits a field with ONE dominant peak and a shoulder -- mostly background with faint objects on it. The level is geometric: the point on the histogram furthest from the line between the peak and the far end.
records.source: Suits a field with ONE dominant peak and a shoulder -- mostly background with faint objects on it. The level is geometric: the point on the histogram furthest from the line between the peak and the far end.
records.translation: 지배적인 봉우리 하나(ONE)와 어깨가 있는 시야 — 대부분 배경이고 흐린 객체가 있는 경우 — 에 적합합니다. 수준은 기하학적으로 정해지며, 봉우리와 반대쪽 끝을 잇는 선에서 가장 먼 히스토그램 지점입니다.

records.key: Suits a field with THREE or more populations -- background, a dim halo and bright objects -- where one level between all of them is a compromise that fits none. Set the class count and which class is the foreground.
records.source: Suits a field with THREE or more populations -- background, a dim halo and bright objects -- where one level between all of them is a compromise that fits none. Set the class count and which class is the foreground.
records.translation: 배경, 흐린 후광, 밝은 객체처럼 세 개(THREE) 이상의 집단이 있는 시야에 적합합니다. 이런 경우 모두 사이의 수준 하나는 어느 것에도 맞지 않는 타협입니다. 클래스 수와 전경 클래스를 설정하세요.

records.key: Suits a field with a long bright tail and little else; Yen maximises an entropy criterion and tends to cut higher than Otsu, keeping only the confident pixels.
records.source: Suits a field with a long bright tail and little else; Yen maximises an entropy criterion and tends to cut higher than Otsu, keeping only the confident pixels.
records.translation: 밝은 꼬리 분포가 길고 그 외에는 거의 없는 시야에 적합합니다. Yen은 엔트로피 기준을 최대화하며 Otsu보다 높게 자르는 경향이 있어, 확실한 픽셀만 남깁니다.

records.key: Suits a field with two clear populations -- objects and background, with a valley between them in the histogram. It is the right first try and the wrong one for a field that is mostly background, where Li or Triangle cut better.
records.source: Suits a field with two clear populations -- objects and background, with a valley between them in the histogram. It is the right first try and the wrong one for a field that is mostly background, where Li or Triangle cut better.
records.translation: 객체와 배경이라는 뚜렷한 두 집단이 있고 히스토그램에서 그 사이에 골짜기가 있는 시야에 적합합니다. 처음 시도하기에 알맞지만, 대부분이 배경인 시야에는 맞지 않으며 그런 경우 Li나 Triangle이 더 잘 자릅니다.

records.key: Suits a histogram with two clear humps and a real valley between them; the level is the bottom of the valley. It refuses a histogram it cannot smooth into two humps, and says so rather than guessing.
records.source: Suits a histogram with two clear humps and a real valley between them; the level is the bottom of the valley. It refuses a histogram it cannot smooth into two humps, and says so rather than guessing.
records.translation: 뚜렷한 두 봉우리와 그 사이에 실제 골짜기가 있는 히스토그램에 적합하며, 수준은 골짜기의 바닥입니다. 두 봉우리로 평활화할 수 없는 히스토그램은 추측하지 않고 거부하며 그렇다고 알립니다.

records.key: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on, and is the only method here that knows what an object looks like rather than only how bright it is. It is slow without a GPU.
records.source: Suits cells and nuclei of the kind Cellpose was trained on, and is the only method here that knows what an object looks like rather than only how bright it is. It is slow without a GPU.
records.translation: Cellpose가 학습한 종류의 세포와 핵에 적합하며, 밝기뿐 아니라 객체의 생김새를 아는 유일한 방법입니다. GPU 없이는 느립니다.

records.key: Suits much what Otsu suits and is the classic Ridler-Calvard iteration: the level settles where it is the mean of the two means either side of it. A reasonable second opinion when Otsu looks wrong.
records.source: Suits much what Otsu suits and is the classic Ridler-Calvard iteration: the level settles where it is the mean of the two means either side of it. A reasonable second opinion when Otsu looks wrong.
records.translation: Otsu와 거의 같은 경우에 적합하며, 고전적인 Ridler-Calvard 반복법입니다. 수준은 그 양쪽 두 평균의 평균이 되는 지점에 수렴합니다. Otsu가 이상해 보일 때 참고할 만한 두 번째 의견입니다.

records.key: Suits small round spots and puncta and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.source: Suits small round spots and puncta and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.translation: 작고 둥근 점과 점상 구조, 가운데가 어두운 속 빈 고리에 적합합니다.

records.key: Suits small round spots and puncta, filaments, tubules and networks, solid blobby objects and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.source: Suits small round spots and puncta, filaments, tubules and networks, solid blobby objects and hollow rings with a dark middle.
records.translation: 작고 둥근 점과 점상 구조, 필라멘트, 세관 및 네트워크, 속이 찬 덩어리 객체, 가운데가 어두운 속 빈 고리에 적합합니다.

records.key: Suits touching round objects with a bright centre -- nuclei, vacuoles, colonies. Each centre becomes one object, and two that touch come apart at the ridge between them rather than at a level.
records.source: Suits touching round objects with a bright centre -- nuclei, vacuoles, colonies. Each centre becomes one object, and two that touch come apart at the ridge between them rather than at a level.
records.translation: 중심이 밝고 서로 맞닿은 둥근 객체 — 핵, 공포, 콜로니 — 에 적합합니다. 각 중심이 하나의 객체가 되며, 맞닿은 두 객체는 특정 수준이 아니라 둘 사이의 능선에서 분리됩니다.

records.key: Supply dose and response columns, controls and units before curve fitting; this route does not require sequencing.
records.source: Supply dose and response columns, controls and units before curve fitting; this route does not require sequencing.
records.translation: 곡선 적합 전에 용량 및 반응 열, 대조군, 단위를 지정하세요. 이 경로에는 시퀀싱이 필요하지 않습니다.

records.key: Supply frame interval and pixel calibration.
records.source: Supply frame interval and pixel calibration.
records.translation: 프레임 간격과 픽셀 보정을 지정하세요.

records.key: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it.
records.source: Supply the encoder feature table with matching object IDs; do not assume every GUI route automatically persists it.
records.translation: 일치하는 객체 ID와 함께 인코더 특징 테이블을 제공하세요. 모든 GUI 경로가 이를 자동으로 저장한다고 가정하지 마세요.

records.key: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection.
records.source: Supply the matching coordinate/feature columns when defining a selection.
records.translation: 선택 영역을 정의할 때 일치하는 좌표/특징 열을 제공하세요.

records.key: Supply the measured project roots and required object/png_list tables. Verify host-cell aggregation and area units before interpreting size bins; the Mask counts database alone is insufficient.
records.source: Supply the measured project roots and required object/png_list tables. Verify host-cell aggregation and area units before interpreting size bins; the Mask counts database alone is insufficient.
records.translation: 측정된 프로젝트 루트와 필요한 객체/png_list 테이블을 제공하세요. 크기 구간을 해석하기 전에 숙주 세포 집계와 면적 단위를 확인하세요. 마스크 개수 데이터베이스만으로는 부족합니다.

records.key: Supply the references that encode your experiment. Inspect mapped counts and barcode QC before pairing well-level guide counts with phenotype scores.
records.source: Supply the references that encode your experiment. Inspect mapped counts and barcode QC before pairing well-level guide counts with phenotype scores.
records.translation: 실험을 인코딩하는 참조를 제공하세요. 웰 수준 가이드 개수를 표현형 점수와 짝짓기 전에 매핑된 개수와 바코드 QC를 검사하세요.

records.key: TIFF fields for direct Cellpose inference
records.source: TIFF fields for direct Cellpose inference
records.translation: Cellpose 직접 추론용 TIFF 시야

records.key:
TIFF, named like E - 01(fld 9 wv DAPI - DAPI).tif. Naming: incell. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

Channels are named by filter, so their order is the order of the names.
records.source:
TIFF, named like E - 01(fld 9 wv DAPI - DAPI).tif. Naming: incell. Fills the Import screen: images, cell / nucleus / pathogen masks and a measurements table, then previews.

Channels are named by filter, so their order is the order of the names.
records.translation:
TIFF, E - 01(fld 9 wv DAPI - DAPI).tif 같은 이름. 명명 규칙: incell. 가져오기 화면에 이미지, 세포/핵/병원체 마스크, 측정 테이블을 채운 다음 미리 봅니다.

채널은 필터 이름으로 지정되므로 이름 순서가 곧 채널 순서입니다.

records.key: The Golgi apparatus is a series of flattened, cisternal membranes and similar vesicles usually arranged in close apposition to each other to form stacks. In mammalian cells, the Golgi apparatus is juxtanuclear, often pericentriolar. The stacks are connected laterally by tubules to create a perinuclear ribbon structure, the 'Golgi ribbon'. In plants and lower animal cells, the Golgi exists as many copies of discrete stacks dispersed throughout the cytoplasm. The Golgi is a polarized structure with, in most higher eukaryotic cells, a cis-face associated with a tubular reticular network of membranes facing the endoplasmic reticulum, the cis-Golgi network (CGN), a medial area of disk-shaped flattened cisternae, and a trans-face associated with another tubular reticular membrane network, the trans-Golgi network (TGN) directed toward the plasma membrane and compartments of the endocytic pathway. The Golgi apparatus receives the entire output of de novo synthesized polypeptides from the ER, and functions to posttranslationally process and sort them within vesicles destined to their proper final destination (e.g. plasma membrane, endosomes, lysosomes).

records.translation: 골지체는 서로 가깝게 배열되어 층판을 이루는 납작한 시스터나 막과 유사한 소포의 연속체입니다. 포유류 세포에서 골지체는 핵 옆에 있으며 흔히 중심소체 주위에 있습니다. 층판들은 세관으로 옆으로 연결되어 핵 주위 리본 구조인 'Golgi ribbon'을 만듭니다. 식물과 하등 동물 세포에서는 골지체가 세포질 전체에 흩어진 여러 개의 개별 층판으로 존재합니다. 골지체는 극성을 가진 구조로, 대부분의 고등 진핵세포에서 소포체를 향한 관상 그물 막 네트워크와 연결된 시스 면인 시스 골지 네트워크(CGN), 원판 모양의 납작한 시스터나로 된 중간 영역, 그리고 원형질막과 세포내 섭취 경로의 구획을 향하는 또 다른 관상 그물 막 네트워크와 연결된 트랜스 면인 트랜스 골지 네트워크(TGN)가 있습니다. 골지체는 새로 합성된 폴리펩타이드 전부를 소포체에서 받아, 번역 후 가공하고 소포에 담아 적절한 최종 목적지(예: 원형질막, 엔도솜, 리소좀)로 분류합니다.

records.source: The bud neck is a constriction between the mother and the daughter cell (bud) in an organism that reproduces by budding. This structure comprises the septin ring, an hourglass-shaped collar around the mother-bud neck, which splits into two rings flanking the division plane at cytokinesis and that acts as a diffusion barrier to maintain polarity factors in the bud and as a scaffold to recruit actomyosin contractile ring components.
records.translation: 출아 목은 출아로 번식하는 생물에서 모세포와 딸세포(출아체) 사이의 잘록한 부분입니다. 이 구조에는 모세포-출아체 목을 둘러싼 모래시계 모양의 고리인 셉틴 고리가 있으며, 세포질 분열 때 분열면 양쪽의 두 고리로 나뉩니다. 셉틴 고리는 출아체 안에 극성 인자를 유지하는 확산 장벽이자, 액토미오신 수축 고리 구성 요소를 모으는 발판 역할을 합니다.

records.key: The cell membrane is the selectively permeable membrane which separates the cytoplasm from its surroundings. Known as the cell inner membrane in prokaryotes with 2 membranes.
records.source: The cell membrane is the selectively permeable membrane which separates the cytoplasm from its surroundings. Known as the cell inner membrane in prokaryotes with 2 membranes.
records.translation: 세포막은 세포질을 주변 환경과 분리하는 선택적 투과성 막입니다. 막이 2개인 원핵생물에서는 세포 내막이라고 합니다.

records.key: The command spaCR runs. Copy it to run it in a terminal yourself instead.
records.source: The command spaCR runs. Copy it to run it in a terminal yourself instead.
records.translation: spaCR이 실행하는 명령입니다. 대신 터미널에서 직접 실행하려면 복사하세요.

records.key: The compartment diagram connects imaging phenotypes to subcellular vocabulary used in Starplast. ToxoDB provides gene and genome context, while UniProt supplies protein annotations. The hyperLOPIT atlas provides experimental localization evidence for Toxoplasma proteins; a highlighted organelle here is a guide to that vocabulary, not a prediction for a selected gene or proof of the cause of a phenotype.

records.translation: 구획 도식은 이미징 표현형을 Starplast에서 사용하는 세포 내 위치 어휘와 연결합니다. ToxoDB는 유전자와 유전체 맥락을, UniProt은 단백질 주석을 제공합니다. hyperLOPIT 아틀라스는 Toxoplasma 단백질의 실험적 위치 근거를 제공합니다. 여기서 강조 표시된 세포소기관은 그 어휘에 대한 안내일 뿐, 선택한 유전자에 대한 예측이나 표현형 원인의 증거가 아닙니다.

records.key: The complex and rigid layer surrounding the cell. Cell walls are found in bacteria, archaea, fungi, plants, and algae. The cell wall envelopes the inner or plasma membrane in all bacteria and is surrounded by the outer membrane in bacteria with 2 membranes (Gram-negative). Bacterial cell walls contain peptidoglycan while those of archaea are not made of peptidoglycan, but some archaea may contain pseudopeptidoglycan, which is composed of N-acetyltalosaminuronic acid, instead of N-acetyl muramic acid in peptidoglycan. The plant cell wall is made of fibrils of cellulose embedded in a matrix of several other kinds of polymers such as pectin and lignin. Algal cell walls are usually composed of cellulose, glycoproteins, sporopollenin, calcium and various polysaccharides such as manosyl, xylanes, alginic acid. Diatom cell walls (or frustules) contain silica. The cell wall plays a role in cell shape, cell stability and development, and protection against environmental dangers.

records.translation: 세포를 둘러싼 복잡하고 단단한 층입니다. 세포벽은 세균, 고세균, 진균, 식물, 조류에서 발견됩니다. 모든 세균에서 세포벽은 내막 또는 원형질막을 감싸며, 막이 2개인 세균(그람 음성)에서는 외막으로 둘러싸여 있습니다. 세균의 세포벽에는 펩티도글리칸이 있지만 고세균의 세포벽은 펩티도글리칸으로 이루어지지 않습니다. 다만 일부 고세균은 펩티도글리칸의 N-아세틸무람산 대신 N-아세틸탈로사민우론산으로 이루어진 슈도펩티도글리칸을 가질 수 있습니다. 식물 세포벽은 펙틴, 리그닌 등 여러 다른 중합체 기질에 박힌 셀룰로스 섬유로 이루어집니다. 조류의 세포벽은 보통 셀룰로스, 당단백질, 스포로폴레닌, 칼슘, 그리고 만노실, 자일란, 알긴산 같은 다양한 다당류로 구성됩니다. 규조류의 세포벽(또는 피각)에는 실리카가 들어 있습니다. 세포벽은 세포 모양, 세포 안정성과 발달, 환경 위험으로부터의 보호에 관여합니다.

records.key: The cytoskeleton is a dynamic three-dimensional filamentous structure in the cytoplasm. Its roles include maintenance of cell shape, cell movement (in eukaryotes), cytokinesis, and the organization of organelles or organelle-like structures within the cell. The cytoskeleton includes microfilaments (actin-like proteins), microtubules (tubulin-like proteins), the intermediate filaments (mostly in eukaryotes) and the MinD-ParA proteins, which appear to be unique to prokaryotes.

records.translation: 세포골격은 세포질 안의 역동적인 3차원 섬유 구조입니다. 세포 모양 유지, (진핵생물의) 세포 운동, 세포질 분열, 세포 내 세포소기관이나 유사 구조의 조직화 등의 역할을 합니다. 세포골격에는 미세섬유(액틴 유사 단백질), 미세소관(튜불린 유사 단백질), 중간섬유(주로 진핵생물), 그리고 원핵생물에 고유한 것으로 보이는 MinD-ParA 단백질이 포함됩니다.

records.key: The detector {key} is not on this machine yet. Download it here, or the run downloads it.
records.source: The detector {key} is not on this machine yet. Download it here, or the run downloads it.
records.translation: 검출기 {key}이(가) 아직 이 컴퓨터에 없습니다. 여기서 다운로드하거나, 실행 시 다운로드됩니다.

records.key: The disk the detection is closed and opened with after it is thresholded. Raise it to smooth ragged outlines, lower it to keep fine detail. The Adaptive mode also pre-smooths with half of it; the network methods close with half of it.
records.source: The disk the detection is closed and opened with after it is thresholded. Raise it to smooth ragged outlines, lower it to keep fine detail. The Adaptive mode also pre-smooths with half of it; the network methods close with half of it.
records.translation: 임계값 적용 후 검출 결과에 닫힘과 열림을 적용할 원판입니다. 들쭉날쭉한 윤곽선을 매끄럽게 하려면 높이고, 미세한 세부를 유지하려면 낮추세요. 적응형 모드는 그 절반으로 사전 평활화하고, 네트워크 방법은 그 절반으로 닫힘을 적용합니다.

records.key: The disk the opening or closing uses, in pixels. It is a length: a bridge narrower than twice this is broken, a gap narrower than twice this is filled.
records.source: The disk the opening or closing uses, in pixels. It is a length: a bridge narrower than twice this is broken, a gap narrower than twice this is filled.
records.translation: 열림 또는 닫힘 연산에 쓰는 원판(픽셀)입니다. 이는 길이로, 이 값의 두 배보다 좁은 연결은 끊기고, 두 배보다 좁은 틈은 메워집니다.

records.key: The endoplasmic reticulum (ER) is an extensive network of membrane tubules, vesicles and flattened cisternae (sac-like structures) found throughout the eukaryotic cell, especially those responsible for the production of hormones and other secretory products. The membrane is a continuation of the outer nuclear membrane, it encloses the cytosol cisternal spaces (or internal lumen), which are continuous with the nuclear periplasmic space. The ER sustains many general functions, including protein synthesis, protein modification, protein folding, insertion of membrane proteins, sequestration of calcium, production of phospholipids and steroids and transport of proteins destined for membranes and secretion.

records.translation: 소포체(ER)는 진핵세포 전체, 특히 호르몬 및 기타 분비물을 생산하는 세포에 널리 분포하는 막 세관, 소포, 납작한 시스터나(주머니 모양 구조)의 광범위한 네트워크입니다. 막은 외핵막과 이어져 있으며, 핵 주변 공간과 이어지는 시스터나 내부 공간(내강)을 둘러쌉니다. ER은 단백질 합성, 단백질 변형, 단백질 접힘, 막단백질 삽입, 칼슘 격리, 인지질과 스테로이드 생산, 막과 분비로 향하는 단백질 수송 등 여러 일반적인 기능을 수행합니다.

records.key: The exponent the intensities are raised to on 0..1. Below 1 lifts the dim end, so faint objects rise out of the background; above 1 pushes it down and leaves only the bright ones. 1.00 is off.
records.source: The exponent the intensities are raised to on 0..1. Below 1 lifts the dim end, so faint objects rise out of the background; above 1 pushes it down and leaves only the bright ones. 1.00 is off.
records.translation: 0..1 범위의 강도에 적용하는 지수입니다. 1보다 작으면 어두운 쪽을 끌어올려 흐린 객체가 배경에서 드러나고, 1보다 크면 끌어내려 밝은 객체만 남습니다. 1.00이면 꺼짐입니다.

records.key: The file table decides this. Change the table's channels or mask columns and this follows.
records.source: The file table decides this. Change the table's channels or mask columns and this follows.
records.translation: 이 값은 파일 표가 결정합니다. 표의 채널 열이나 마스크 열을 바꾸면 이 값도 따라 바뀝니다.

records.source: The fitted tabular classifier and its recorded feature list, training settings and validation results.
records.translation: 적합된 표 형식 분류기와 기록된 특징 목록, 학습 설정, 검증 결과.

records.key: The inner membrane complex, found in apicocomplexan parasites, is composed of flattened membrane cisternae closely associated to the cell membrane. Together, the cell membrane and the IMC form a triple lipid bilayer called the pellicle (or cell wall).
records.source: The inner membrane complex, found in apicocomplexan parasites, is composed of flattened membrane cisternae closely associated to the cell membrane. Together, the cell membrane and the IMC form a triple lipid bilayer called the pellicle (or cell wall).
records.translation: 정단복합체 기생충에서 발견되는 내막 복합체(IMC)는 세포막과 밀접하게 연결된 납작한 막 시스터나로 이루어집니다. 세포막과 IMC는 함께 펠리클(또는 세포벽)이라 불리는 삼중 지질 이중층을 형성합니다.

records.key: The installed feature dictionary; definitions describe existing measurements and do not compute them.
records.source: The installed feature dictionary; definitions describe existing measurements and do not compute them.
records.translation: 설치된 특징 사전입니다. 정의는 기존 측정값을 설명할 뿐 계산하지 않습니다.

records.key: The larger of the two Gaussians, in pixels. Scales step up from the low sigma by a factor of 1.6 until this bound, so a wider gap covers more spot sizes and costs more passes.
records.source: The larger of the two Gaussians, in pixels. Scales step up from the low sigma by a factor of 1.6 until this bound, so a wider gap covers more spot sizes and costs more passes.
records.translation: 두 가우스 중 큰 쪽(픽셀)입니다. 스케일은 낮은 시그마에서 1.6배씩 이 한계까지 커지므로, 간격이 넓을수록 더 많은 점 크기를 다루지만 더 많은 패스가 필요합니다.

records.source: The largest scale searched, in pixels. Raise it to catch large puncta; the filter runs once per scale, so it costs time.
records.translation: 탐색하는 가장 큰 스케일(픽셀)입니다. 큰 점상 구조를 잡으려면 높이세요. 필터가 스케일마다 한 번씩 실행되므로 시간이 더 걸립니다.

records.translation: 검출기가 그림에서 찾은 웰 주위에 그리는 상자의 선 굵기(이미지 픽셀)입니다. 자동은 그림 크기에서 너비를 정합니다: 2 px에 긴 변 400 px마다 1씩 더합니다. 강조 표시된 웰의 상자는 두 배 굵게 그립니다. 세션 간에 기억됩니다.

records.key: The line weight of the well boxes is set there too.
records.source: The line weight of the well boxes is set there too.
records.translation: 웰 상자의 선 굵기도 그곳에서 설정합니다.

records.key: The membrane surrounding a mitochondrion. This term is used when it is not known if the protein is found in or associated with the inner or outer mitochondrial membrane.
records.source: The membrane surrounding a mitochondrion. This term is used when it is not known if the protein is found in or associated with the inner or outer mitochondrial membrane.
records.translation: 미토콘드리아를 둘러싼 막입니다. 단백질이 미토콘드리아 내막 또는 외막에 있거나 연관되어 있는지 알 수 없을 때 이 용어를 사용합니다.

records.key: The microneme is an Apicomplexan parasite organelle. Apicomplexa are named for the unique set of morphologically distinct secretory organelles (refered to as the apical complex)- micronemes, rhoptries and dense granules - whose sequential secretion is required for the invasion of host cells. Micronemes are the smallest, they are involved in the early stages of invasion.
records.source: The microneme is an Apicomplexan parasite organelle. Apicomplexa are named for the unique set of morphologically distinct secretory organelles (refered to as the apical complex)- micronemes, rhoptries and dense granules - whose sequential secretion is required for the invasion of host cells. Micronemes are the smallest, they are involved in the early stages of invasion.
records.translation: 미크로넴은 정단복합체 기생충의 세포소기관입니다. 정단복합체충(Apicomplexa)이라는 이름은 형태적으로 구별되는 고유한 분비 세포소기관 세트(정단 복합체라고 함) — 미크로넴, 롭트리, 치밀 과립 — 에서 유래하며, 이들의 순차적 분비는 숙주 세포 침입에 필요합니다. 미크로넴은 가장 작으며 침입 초기 단계에 관여합니다.

records.key: The mitochondrion is a semiautonomous, self-reproducing organelle that occurs in the cytoplasm of all cells of most, but not all, eukaryotes. Each mitochondrion is surrounded by a double limiting membrane. The inner membrane is highly invaginated, and its projections are called cristae. Mitochondria are the sites of the reactions of oxidative phosphorylation, which result in the formation of ATP. The size and coding capacity of the mitochondrial DNA varies considerably in different organisms, and encodes rRNAs, tRNAs and essential mitochondrial proteins.
records.source: The mitochondrion is a semiautonomous, self-reproducing organelle that occurs in the cytoplasm of all cells of most, but not all, eukaryotes. Each mitochondrion is surrounded by a double limiting membrane. The inner membrane is highly invaginated, and its projections are called cristae. Mitochondria are the sites of the reactions of oxidative phosphorylation, which result in the formation of ATP. The size and coding capacity of the mitochondrial DNA varies considerably in different organisms, and encodes rRNAs, tRNAs and essential mitochondrial proteins.
records.translation: 미토콘드리아는 대부분의(전부는 아닌) 진핵생물의 모든 세포 세포질에 있는 반자율적 자기 복제 세포소기관입니다. 각 미토콘드리아는 이중 한계막으로 둘러싸여 있습니다. 내막은 깊이 함입되어 있으며, 그 돌출부를 크리스타라고 합니다. 미토콘드리아는 ATP를 생성하는 산화적 인산화 반응이 일어나는 장소입니다. 미토콘드리아 DNA의 크기와 암호화 용량은 생물마다 크게 다르며, rRNA, tRNA 및 필수 미토콘드리아 단백질을 암호화합니다.

records.key: The nucleolus is a non-membrane bound nuclear compartment found in eukaryotic cells which is the site of ribosome biogenesis. The interphase nucleolus is organized around the tandemly repeated genes for preribosomal RNA (rRNA). It is composed of at least 2 sub-compartments: the dense fibrillar component (DFC, also called pars fibrosa) and the granular component (GC or pars granulosa). The DFC contains newly synthesized preribosomal RNA and a collection of proteins; the GC is made up of nearly completed preribosomal particles destined for the cytoplasm. In most metazoans, but generally not in lower eukaryotes, a third component, the fibrillar center (FC), can be seen. Plant and animal nuclei can contain more than one nucleolus.

The interphase nucleolus is organized around the tandemly repeated genes for preribosomal RNA (rRNA). It is composed of at least 2 sub-compartments: the dense fibrillar component (DFC, also called pars fibrosa) and the granular component (GC or pars granulosa). The DFC contains newly synthesized preribosomal RNA and a collection of proteins; the GC is made up of nearly completed preribosomal particles destined for the cytoplasm. In most metazoans, but generally not in lower eukaryotes, a third component, the fibrillar center (FC), can be seen. Plant and animal nuclei can contain more than one nucleolus.
records.translation: 인은 진핵세포에서 발견되는 막으로 둘러싸이지 않은 핵 내 구획으로, 리보솜 생합성이 일어나는 장소입니다. 간기 인은 전구 리보솜 RNA(rRNA)를 암호화하는 직렬 반복 유전자를 중심으로 조직됩니다. 최소 2개의 하위 구획으로 구성됩니다: 치밀 섬유 성분(DFC, pars fibrosa라고도 함)과 과립 성분(GC 또는 pars granulosa). DFC에는 새로 합성된 전구 리보솜 RNA와 여러 단백질이 있고, GC는 세포질로 향하는 거의 완성된 전구 리보솜 입자로 이루어져 있습니다. 대부분의 후생동물에서는(하등 진핵생물에서는 일반적으로 아님) 세 번째 성분인 섬유 중심(FC)을 볼 수 있습니다. 식물과 동물의 핵에는 인이 둘 이상 있을 수 있습니다.

records.key: The nucleus is the most obvious organelle in any eukaryotic cell. It is a membrane-bound organelle surrounded by double membranes which contains most of the cell's genetic material. It communicates with the surrounding cytosol via numerous nuclear pores.
records.source: The nucleus is the most obvious organelle in any eukaryotic cell. It is a membrane-bound organelle surrounded by double membranes which contains most of the cell's genetic material. It communicates with the surrounding cytosol via numerous nuclear pores.
records.translation: 핵은 모든 진핵세포에서 가장 뚜렷한 세포소기관입니다. 이중막으로 둘러싸인 막결합 세포소기관으로, 세포 유전 물질의 대부분을 담고 있습니다. 수많은 핵공을 통해 주변 세포기질과 소통합니다.

records.key: The number the rule above reads: a fraction from 0 to 1 for the per-centre rule, an intensity for the absolute one, a percentile from 0 to 100 for the third. Not read when a threshold algorithm provides the level.
records.source: The number the rule above reads: a fraction from 0 to 1 for the per-centre rule, an intensity for the absolute one, a percentile from 0 to 100 for the third. Not read when a threshold algorithm provides the level.
records.translation: 위의 규칙이 읽는 숫자입니다: 중심별 규칙에는 0부터 1까지의 비율, 절대 규칙에는 강도, 세 번째 규칙에는 0부터 100까지의 백분위수. 임계값 알고리즘이 수준을 제공하면 읽지 않습니다.

records.key: The output location chosen by the tool; exports describe the selected data and filters.
records.source: The output location chosen by the tool; exports describe the selected data and filters.
records.translation: 도구가 선택한 출력 위치입니다. 내보내기에는 선택한 데이터와 필터가 기술됩니다.

records.key: The planned Egress module will focus on vacuole rupture and parasite exit; Gliding motility will quantify extracellular trails and movement. Bradyzoite conversion will address stage-marker and cyst-wall readouts, while Host cell damage will describe monolayer loss. These are proposed workflows, so their tiles are marked Coming soon. Fixed images, time series and stage-specific markers answer different questions and should be selected for the intended readout.
records.source: The planned Egress module will focus on vacuole rupture and parasite exit; Gliding motility will quantify extracellular trails and movement. Fixed images, time series and stage-specific markers answer different questions and should be selected for the intended readout.
records.translation: 계획된 탈출 모듈은 공포 파열과 기생충의 탈출에 초점을 두고, 활주 운동성은 세포 밖 흔적과 움직임을 정량화할 예정입니다. 브래디조이트 전환은 단계 마커와 낭포벽 판독값을, 숙주세포 손상은 단층 소실을 다룹니다. 이들은 제안된 워크플로이므로 타일에 출시 예정으로 표시되어 있습니다. 고정 이미지, 시계열, 단계 특이 마커는 서로 다른 질문에 답하므로 의도한 판독값에 맞게 선택해야 합니다.

records.key: The preview's settings, in two tabs: Figure (finding the plaque wells and reading the figure) and Plaque detection (the plaque model and its thresholds).
records.source: The preview's settings, in two tabs: Figure (finding the plaque wells and reading the figure) and Plaque detection (the plaque model and its thresholds).
records.translation: 미리보기 설정은 두 탭으로 되어 있습니다: 그림(플라크 웰을 찾고 그림을 판독)과 플라크 검출(플라크 모델과 임계값).

records.key: The proposed Adhesion module will count fungal cells associated with a host-cell surface. Biofilm will focus on collective growth, including covered area and thickness when the acquisition contains depth information. A single two-dimensional field can describe surface coverage but cannot by itself establish biofilm thickness. Choose single-plane or volumetric imaging to match the endpoint.
records.source: The proposed Adhesion module will count fungal cells associated with a host-cell surface. Biofilm will focus on collective growth, including covered area and thickness when the acquisition contains depth information. A single two-dimensional field can describe surface coverage but cannot by itself establish biofilm thickness. Choose single-plane or volumetric imaging to match the endpoint.
records.translation: 제안된 부착 모듈은 숙주 세포 표면에 붙은 진균 세포를 셀 예정입니다. 바이오필름은 집단 성장에 초점을 두며, 획득 데이터에 깊이 정보가 있으면 덮인 면적과 두께도 포함합니다. 2차원 시야 하나로는 표면 피복을 설명할 수 있지만 그것만으로 바이오필름 두께를 확정할 수는 없습니다. 종점에 맞게 단일 평면 또는 부피 이미징을 선택하세요.

records.key: The proposed Parasitaemia module will count infected red blood cells relative to the total red-cell population. Blood-stage staging will separate rings, trophozoites and schizonts so a shift in stage composition can be examined alongside infection frequency. Merozoite invasion will focus on entry into red blood cells. Together these readouts would help distinguish fewer newly infected cells from altered development of parasites already inside them.
records.source: The proposed Parasitaemia module will count infected red blood cells relative to the total red-cell population. Blood-stage staging will separate rings, trophozoites and schizonts so a shift in stage composition can be examined alongside infection frequency. Merozoite invasion will focus on entry into red blood cells. Together these readouts would help distinguish fewer newly infected cells from altered development of parasites already inside them.
records.translation: 제안된 기생충혈증 모듈은 전체 적혈구 집단 대비 감염된 적혈구를 셀 예정입니다. 혈액기 단계 분류는 링, 영양형, 분열체를 구분하여 단계 구성의 변화를 감염 빈도와 함께 검토할 수 있게 합니다. 메로조이트 침입은 적혈구로의 진입에 초점을 둡니다. 이 판독값들을 함께 쓰면 새로 감염된 세포가 적은 것과 이미 안에 있는 기생충의 발달이 바뀐 것을 구별하는 데 도움이 됩니다.

records.key: The published documentation is not reachable from here, so this is the description stored with the code on this machine.
records.source: The published documentation is not reachable from here, so this is the description stored with the code on this machine.
records.translation: 게시된 문서에 여기서 접속할 수 없으므로, 이 컴퓨터의 코드와 함께 저장된 설명을 표시합니다.

records.key: The rhoptry is an Apicomplexan parasite organelle. Apicomplexa are named for the unique set of morphologically distinct secretory organelles (refered to as the apical complex)- micronemes, rhoptries and dense granules - whose sequential secretion is required for the invasion of host cells. Rhoptries are twin, membrane-bound, pear-shaped organelles that secrete proteins through their elongated necks at the apical tip of the parasite.
records.source: The rhoptry is an Apicomplexan parasite organelle. Apicomplexa are named for the unique set of morphologically distinct secretory organelles (refered to as the apical complex)- micronemes, rhoptries and dense granules - whose sequential secretion is required for the invasion of host cells. Rhoptries are twin, membrane-bound, pear-shaped organelles that secrete proteins through their elongated necks at the apical tip of the parasite.
records.translation: 롭트리는 정단복합체 기생충의 세포소기관입니다. 정단복합체충(Apicomplexa)이라는 이름은 형태적으로 구별되는 고유한 분비 세포소기관 세트(정단 복합체라고 함) — 미크로넴, 롭트리, 치밀 과립 — 에서 유래하며, 이들의 순차적 분비는 숙주 세포 침입에 필요합니다. 롭트리는 쌍을 이루는 막결합 서양배 모양 세포소기관으로, 기생충 정단 끝의 길쭉한 목을 통해 단백질을 분비합니다.

records.key: The scales the filter looks for, in pixels, separated by commas; each should be about the half-width of a filament. Add a larger value for thick bundles and keep the small ones for fine tubules. Runtime grows with the list.
records.source: The scales the filter looks for, in pixels, separated by commas; each should be about the half-width of a filament. Add a larger value for thick bundles and keep the small ones for fine tubules. Runtime grows with the list.
records.translation: 필터가 찾는 스케일(픽셀, 쉼표로 구분)입니다. 각 값은 필라멘트 반폭 정도여야 합니다. 굵은 다발에는 큰 값을 추가하고, 가는 세관에는 작은 값을 유지하세요. 실행 시간은 목록 길이에 따라 늘어납니다.

records.key: The second reading changed: press Run preview to read the figure again.
records.source: The second reading changed: press Run preview to read the figure again.
records.translation: 두 번째 판독이 바뀌었습니다. 그림을 다시 읽으려면 미리보기 실행을 누르세요.

records.key: The side of one tile, in pixels. Comfortably larger than one object and smaller than the scale the illumination varies on; a tile the size of one object equalises the object against itself.
records.source: The side of one tile, in pixels. Comfortably larger than one object and smaller than the scale the illumination varies on; a tile the size of one object equalises the object against itself.
records.translation: 타일 한 변의 길이(픽셀)입니다. 객체 하나보다 넉넉히 크고, 조명이 변하는 스케일보다 작게 하세요. 객체 하나 크기의 타일은 객체를 자기 자신에 맞춰 평활화합니다.

records.key: The sign-in could not be started from here. Run the command below in a terminal, then press Done.
records.source: The sign-in could not be started from here. Run the command below in a terminal, then press Done.
records.translation: 여기서 로그인을 시작할 수 없습니다. 아래 명령을 터미널에서 실행한 다음 완료를 누르세요.

records.key: The sign-in ended without success (exit code {code}). What it said is above.
records.source: The sign-in ended without success (exit code {code}). What it said is above.
records.translation: 로그인이 성공하지 못하고 끝났습니다(종료 코드 {code}). 출력 내용은 위에 있습니다.

records.key: The smaller of the two Gaussians, in pixels: the finest detail kept. Raise it to suppress noise.
records.source: The smaller of the two Gaussians, in pixels: the finest detail kept. Raise it to suppress noise.
records.translation: 두 가우스 중 작은 쪽(픽셀)으로, 유지되는 가장 미세한 세부입니다. 잡음을 억제하려면 높이세요.

records.key: The smallest scale searched, in pixels; a blob's radius is about sigma times the square root of two, so 1 finds roughly 1.4 px puncta. Raise it to ignore single-pixel noise.
records.source: The smallest scale searched, in pixels; a blob's radius is about sigma times the square root of two, so 1 finds roughly 1.4 px puncta. Raise it to ignore single-pixel noise.
records.translation: 탐색하는 가장 작은 스케일(픽셀)입니다. 블롭의 반지름은 대략 시그마에 2의 제곱근을 곱한 값이므로, 1이면 약 1.4 px 크기의 점상 구조를 찾습니다. 단일 픽셀 잡음을 무시하려면 높이세요.

records.key: The square the local threshold is measured in, centred on each pixel; the engine forces it odd. A few times the object diameter is the starting point: too small and the middle of a large object becomes its own background, too large and it is a whole-field threshold again.
records.source: The square the local threshold is measured in, centred on each pixel; the engine forces it odd. A few times the object diameter is the starting point: too small and the middle of a large object becomes its own background, too large and it is a whole-field threshold again.
records.translation: 각 픽셀을 중심으로 국소 임계값을 측정하는 정사각형이며, 엔진이 홀수로 맞춥니다. 객체 직경의 몇 배로 시작하세요. 너무 작으면 큰 객체의 가운데가 자체 배경이 되고, 너무 크면 다시 시야 전체 임계값이 됩니다.

records.key: The table shows the first 500 vacuoles; field totals include every measured vacuole.
records.source: The table shows the first 500 vacuoles; field totals include every measured vacuole.
records.translation: 표에는 처음 500개 공포가 표시되며, 시야 합계에는 측정된 모든 공포가 포함됩니다.

records.source: The update is installed, but the current settings could not be saved for restart. Keep this window open until you have saved your work, then restart spaCR.

records.source: The update is installed. Restart was deferred while work finishes shutting down; restart spaCR after it stops.
records.translation: 업데이트가 설치되었습니다. 작업이 종료되는 동안 다시 시작을 미뤘습니다. 작업이 멈춘 뒤 spaCR을 다시 시작하세요.

records.key: The vacuole is a generally large fluid-filled membrane-bound compartment in the cytoplasm. The precise form and function of vacuoles may vary between phyla. Plant vacuoles are among the best characterized. They differ in terms of their lumenal contents and processing enzymes, as well as on the basis of the type of integral proteins in their membranes (tonoplast intrinsic proteins, TIPs). Examples include the lytic vacuole, the storage vacuole and the lutoid. One important function of plant vacuoles is the maintenance of hydrostatic pressure. Other eukaryotes employ vacuoles for a variety of purposes, including storage (as in the yeast lysosome/vacuole), secretion and phagocytosis. In Protozoa, contractile vacuoles can be used to discharge water from the cytoplasm to the external environment.

records.translation: 액포는 세포질 안에 있는 일반적으로 크고 액체로 채워진 막결합 구획입니다. 액포의 정확한 형태와 기능은 문에 따라 다를 수 있습니다. 식물 액포는 가장 잘 특성화된 것 중 하나입니다. 식물 액포는 내강 내용물과 처리 효소, 그리고 막의 내재 단백질 유형(액포막 내재 단백질, TIPs)에 따라 구별됩니다. 예로는 용해성 액포, 저장 액포, 루토이드가 있습니다. 식물 액포의 중요한 기능 중 하나는 정수압 유지입니다. 다른 진핵생물은 저장(효모의 리소좀/액포처럼), 분비, 식세포작용 등 다양한 목적으로 액포를 사용합니다. 원생동물에서는 수축 액포가 세포질의 물을 외부 환경으로 배출하는 데 쓰일 수 있습니다.

records.key: The width of each plaque outline, in image pixels. It is drawn on the image itself, so it keeps its share of the picture at any zoom and in a saved picture. Remembered between sessions.
records.source: The width of each plaque outline, in image pixels. It is drawn on the image itself, so it keeps its share of the picture at any zoom and in a saved picture. Remembered between sessions.
records.translation: 각 플라크 윤곽선의 너비(이미지 픽셀)입니다. 이미지 자체에 그려지므로 어떤 배율에서도, 저장된 그림에서도 그림 안에서의 비율이 유지됩니다. 세션 간에 기억됩니다.

records.key: The {names} masks need fresh QC; their old cards are excluded from current findings.
records.source: The {names} masks need fresh QC; their old cards are excluded from current findings.
records.translation: {names} 마스크는 새 QC가 필요합니다. 이전 카드는 현재 결과에서 제외됩니다.

records.source: There is nothing in the console to report.
records.translation: 콘솔에 보고할 내용이 없습니다.

records.key:
These models are uploaded by other spaCR users through the Add button.

Nobody has checked what they are, what they were trained on, or whether the numbers they report are real. Their checksums prove only that a file has not changed since it was uploaded -- not that it is any good, and not that it is safe to trust with your data.

Show them anyway?

records.translation:
이 모델들은 다른 spaCR 사용자가 추가 버튼으로 업로드한 것입니다.

모델이 무엇인지, 무엇으로 학습했는지, 보고된 숫자가 사실인지 아무도 확인하지 않았습니다. 체크섬은 업로드 이후 파일이 바뀌지 않았다는 것만 증명할 뿐 -- 모델이 좋다거나 데이터를 맡겨도 안전하다는 것을 증명하지 않습니다.

그래도 표시할까요?

records.key: These numbers become the model's table on Hugging Face. Leave anything you did not measure blank — it will read “not recorded”, which is better than a guess.
records.source: These numbers become the model's table on Hugging Face. Leave anything you did not measure blank — it will read “not recorded”, which is better than a guess.
records.translation: 이 숫자들은 Hugging Face에서 모델의 표가 됩니다. 측정하지 않은 항목은 비워 두세요 — “기록되지 않음”으로 표시되며, 추측보다 낫습니다.

records.key: Third-party measurement CSV/database tables and their image, mask and object-identity mappings.
records.source: Third-party measurement CSV/database tables and their image, mask and object-identity mappings.
