records.source: This build of spaCR cannot install packages into itself. Install spaCR with pip or conda to add {name}.
records.translation: 이 spaCR 빌드는 자신에게 패키지를 설치할 수 없습니다. {name}을(를) 추가하려면 pip 또는 conda로 spaCR을 설치하세요.

records.key: This crop is not a suggestion; a number key labels it.
records.source: This crop is not a suggestion; a number key labels it.
records.translation: 이 크롭은 제안이 아닙니다. 숫자 키로 레이블을 지정하세요.

records.key: This field: {hosts} hosts, {infected} infected, {vacuoles} vacuoles, {orphans} orphan parasites. The host denominator includes measured uninfected cells; this is not a whole-plate rate.
records.source: This field: {hosts} hosts, {infected} infected, {vacuoles} vacuoles, {orphans} orphan parasites. The host denominator includes measured uninfected cells; this is not a whole-plate rate.
records.translation: 이 시야: 숙주 {hosts}, 감염 {infected}, 공포 {vacuoles}, 고아 기생충 {orphans}. 숙주 분모에는 측정된 비감염 세포가 포함되며, 플레이트 전체 비율이 아닙니다.

records.key: This is the copy on this machine. The published page is reachable — open it for the rendered version.
records.source: This is the copy on this machine. The published page is reachable — open it for the rendered version.
records.translation: 이 컴퓨터에 있는 사본입니다. 게시된 페이지에 접속할 수 있으니, 렌더링된 버전을 보려면 여세요.

records.key: This is the description stored with the code on this machine. Checking whether the published page is reachable…
records.source: This is the description stored with the code on this machine. Checking whether the published page is reachable…
records.translation: 이 컴퓨터의 코드와 함께 저장된 설명입니다. 게시된 페이지에 접속할 수 있는지 확인하는 중…

records.key: This model publishes no checksum, so spaCR cannot tell a truncated or substituted file from the real one.
records.source: This model publishes no checksum, so spaCR cannot tell a truncated or substituted file from the real one.
records.translation: 이 모델은 체크섬을 게시하지 않으므로 spaCR이 잘리거나 바뀐 파일을 실제 파일과 구별할 수 없습니다.

records.key: This page: {suggested} suggested · {confirmed} confirmed · {rejected} rejected · {left} left. Whole column: {tleft} left to judge · {tconfirmed} confirmed · {trejected} rejected.
records.source: This page: {suggested} suggested · {confirmed} confirmed · {rejected} rejected · {left} left. Whole column: {tleft} left to judge · {tconfirmed} confirmed · {trejected} rejected.
records.translation: 이 페이지: 제안 {suggested} · 확인 {confirmed} · 거부 {rejected} · 남음 {left}. 열 전체: 판정 남음 {tleft} · 확인 {tconfirmed} · 거부 {trejected}.

records.key: This spaCR runs from the source checkout at {path}. Update that checkout with git pull to receive source changes. No package upgrade was performed.
records.source: This spaCR runs from the source checkout at {path}. Update that checkout with git pull to receive source changes. No package upgrade was performed.
records.translation: 이 spaCR은 {path}의 소스 체크아웃에서 실행됩니다. 소스 변경 사항을 받으려면 git pull로 해당 체크아웃을 업데이트하세요. 패키지 업그레이드는 수행되지 않았습니다.

records.key: This template is for the {source} module, not {target}.
records.source: This template is for the {source} module, not {target}.
records.translation: 이 템플릿은 {source} 모듈용이며, {target}용이 아닙니다.

records.key: This template was saved with spaCR {made}; you are running {now}. Settings that changed meaning or name in between are applied as written.
records.source: This template was saved with spaCR {made}; you are running {now}. Settings that changed meaning or name in between are applied as written.
records.translation: 이 템플릿은 spaCR {made}에서 저장되었으며, 현재 {now}을(를) 실행 중입니다. 그 사이 의미나 이름이 바뀐 설정은 기록된 그대로 적용됩니다.

records.key: Through the view — an outline drawn on the 3D view at any angle, extended straight through the volume
records.source: Through the view — an outline drawn on the 3D view at any angle, extended straight through the volume
records.translation: 보기 기준 — 3D 보기에서 임의의 각도로 그린 윤곽선을 볼륨 전체로 곧게 연장

records.key: Tick the masks and images to lay over one another. The top row is drawn on top; the arrows move a row up or down the stack.
records.source: Tick the masks and images to lay over one another. The top row is drawn on top; the arrows move a row up or down the stack.
records.translation: 서로 겹쳐 볼 마스크와 이미지를 체크하세요. 맨 위 행이 가장 위에 그려지며, 화살표로 행을 스택에서 위아래로 옮깁니다.

records.key: Top-level, lowercase .tif files in src; existing same-name files in src/masks are skipped. Supply the configured channels and a compatible stock model_name or custom_model checkpoint.
records.source: Top-level, lowercase .tif files in src; existing same-name files in src/masks are skipped. Supply the configured channels and a compatible stock model_name or custom_model checkpoint.
records.translation: src 최상위의 소문자 .tif 파일이며, src/masks에 같은 이름의 파일이 있으면 건너뜁니다. 설정된 채널과 호환되는 기본 model_name 또는 custom_model 체크포인트를 지정하세요.

records.key: Toxoplasma gondii is an intracellular protozoan parasite that causes toxoplasmosis in humans and other warm-blooded animals. Its rapidly growing tachyzoites and persistent tissue cysts represent different stages of infection. Imaging can follow entry into host cells, replication within vacuoles, and damage to a cell monolayer.
records.source: Toxoplasma gondii is an intracellular protozoan parasite that causes toxoplasmosis in humans and other warm-blooded animals. Its rapidly growing tachyzoites and persistent tissue cysts represent different stages of infection. Imaging can follow entry into host cells, replication within vacuoles, and damage to a cell monolayer.
records.translation: Toxoplasma gondii는 사람과 기타 온혈동물에서 톡소플라스마증을 일으키는 세포내 원생동물 기생충입니다. 빠르게 증식하는 급속분열소체(tachyzoite)와 지속되는 조직 낭포는 서로 다른 감염 단계를 나타냅니다. 이미징으로 숙주 세포로의 침입, 공포 내 증식, 세포 단층의 손상을 추적할 수 있습니다.

records.key: Tracked labels and frame/object associations from the time-series project, with frame interval and units.
records.source: Tracked labels and frame/object associations from the time-series project, with frame interval and units.
records.translation: 시계열 프로젝트의 추적된 레이블과 프레임/객체 연관 정보, 프레임 간격 및 단위 포함.

records.key: Train a feature-based classifier from measured objects and labels. Inspect missing-feature exclusions and grouped held-out performance before using scores.
records.source: Train a feature-based classifier from measured objects and labels. Inspect missing-feature exclusions and grouped held-out performance before using scores.
records.translation: 측정된 객체와 레이블로 특징 기반 분류기를 학습하세요. 점수를 사용하기 전에 누락 특징 제외와 그룹별 보류 성능을 검사하세요.

records.key: Train an image classifier from labelled object crops, archives or supported streamed crops. Match channels and preprocessing when applying its checkpoint.
records.source: Train an image classifier from labelled object crops, archives or supported streamed crops. Match channels and preprocessing when applying its checkpoint.
records.translation: 레이블이 지정된 객체 크롭, 아카이브 또는 지원되는 스트리밍 크롭으로 이미지 분류기를 학습하세요. 체크포인트를 적용할 때 채널과 전처리를 일치시키세요.

records.key: Try every convention over the source folder and rank them by how many names each one reads. This only reports — the setting is not changed for you.
records.source: Try every convention over the source folder and rank them by how many names each one reads. This only reports — the setting is not changed for you.
records.translation: 소스 폴더에 모든 규칙을 시도하고 각 규칙이 읽는 이름 수로 순위를 매깁니다. 보고만 할 뿐 설정은 바뀌지 않습니다.

records.key: Turn the volume freely: drag sideways and up and down at once, and it stays wherever you let go.
records.source: Turn the volume freely: drag sideways and up and down at once, and it stays wherever you let go.
records.translation: 볼륨을 자유롭게 돌립니다. 좌우와 상하로 동시에 끌 수 있으며, 놓은 위치에 그대로 머뭅니다.

records.key: Unknown measurements are not negative calls.
records.source: Unknown measurements are not negative calls.
records.translation: 알 수 없는 측정값은 음성 판정이 아닙니다.

records.key: Upgrade Starplast through pip from PyPI in its separate environment at {path}. Close any running Starplast windows before upgrading. Starplast is in alpha; downloads and disk usage depend on the release. spaCR's packages are not changed.
records.source: Upgrade Starplast through pip from PyPI in its separate environment at {path}. Close any running Starplast windows before upgrading. Starplast is in alpha; downloads and disk usage depend on the release. spaCR's packages are not changed.
records.translation: {path}에 있는 별도 환경에서 PyPI의 pip으로 Starplast를 업그레이드합니다. 업그레이드하기 전에 실행 중인 Starplast 창을 모두 닫으세요. Starplast는 알파 단계이며, 다운로드와 디스크 사용량은 릴리스에 따라 다릅니다. spaCR의 패키지는 바뀌지 않습니다.

records.key: Use FEATURES to pair images and masks and write a measured project; standalone masks are not merged arrays.
records.source: Use FEATURES to pair images and masks and write a measured project; standalone masks are not merged arrays.
records.translation: FEATURES로 이미지와 마스크를 짝짓고 측정된 프로젝트를 쓰세요. 독립 마스크는 병합 배열이 아닙니다.

records.key: Use Load test data within a module to load its example project. Home's pathway walkthroughs explain where to start and how the modules pass data to one another.
records.source: Use Load test data within a module to load its example project. Home's pathway walkthroughs explain where to start and how the modules pass data to one another.
records.translation: 모듈의 테스트 데이터 불러오기로 해당 예제 프로젝트를 불러오세요. 홈의 경로 둘러보기에서 어디서 시작하는지, 모듈 간에 데이터가 어떻게 전달되는지 설명합니다.

records.key: Use Measure to export object crops. Select the project containing the merged images and masks, then enable crop saving and choose the object type.
records.source: Use Measure to export object crops. Select the project containing the merged images and masks, then enable crop saving and choose the object type.
records.translation: 측정을 사용해 객체 크롭을 내보내세요. 병합된 이미지와 마스크가 있는 프로젝트를 선택한 다음 크롭 저장을 켜고 객체 유형을 선택하세요.

records.key: Use compartment intensity measurements and matching host/pathogen identities to compute recruitment ratios.
records.source: Use compartment intensity measurements and matching host/pathogen identities to compute recruitment ratios.
records.translation: 구획 강도 측정값과 일치하는 숙주/병원체 식별 정보로 리크루트먼트 비율을 계산하세요.

records.key: Use imported image planes and identities; image-only imports still need segmentation.
records.source: Use imported image planes and identities; image-only imports still need segmentation.
records.translation: 가져온 이미지 평면과 식별 정보를 사용하세요. 이미지만 가져온 경우에도 분할이 필요합니다.

records.key: Use independently checked image/mask pairs.
records.source: Use independently checked image/mask pairs.
records.translation: 독립적으로 검증된 이미지/마스크 쌍을 사용하세요.

records.key: Use plaque masks with matching source images; cell masks are not automatically plaque labels.
records.source: Use plaque masks with matching source images; cell masks are not automatically plaque labels.
records.translation: 일치하는 원본 이미지와 함께 플라크 마스크를 사용하세요. 세포 마스크가 자동으로 플라크 레이블이 되지는 않습니다.

records.key: Use sequencing-cycle images and phenotype alignment to decode barcodes per nucleus. Aggregate/join the decoded identities to compatible phenotype inputs before Regression; the OPS database is not a drop-in FASTQ count CSV.
records.source: Use sequencing-cycle images and phenotype alignment to decode barcodes per nucleus. Aggregate/join the decoded identities to compatible phenotype inputs before Regression; the OPS database is not a drop-in FASTQ count CSV.
records.translation: 시퀀싱 사이클 이미지와 표현형 정렬을 사용하여 핵마다 바코드를 디코딩하세요. 회귀 전에 디코딩된 식별 정보를 호환되는 표현형 입력에 집계/결합하세요. OPS 데이터베이스는 FASTQ 개수 CSV를 바로 대체할 수 없습니다.

records.key: Use the Python sweep API to explore stated screen-design assumptions. It expands combinations, runs simulations in a process pool and writes synthetic summary statistics; it returns None. Set a small explicit max_workers value and a bounded parameter grid before running. The output does not replace measurements or barcode counts for experimental Regression. Use the findings as planning evidence, with their assumptions recorded. Review the synthetic summaries when choosing planning assumptions; transfer those assumptions manually into Power / Design or Experiment Design. Neither tool imports this simulation database, and neither exports the simulation settings grid.
records.source: Use the Python sweep API to explore stated screen-design assumptions. It expands combinations, runs simulations in a process pool and writes synthetic summary statistics; it returns None. Set a small explicit max_workers value and a bounded parameter grid before running. The output does not replace measurements or barcode counts for experimental Regression. Use the findings as planning evidence, with their assumptions recorded. Review the synthetic summaries when choosing planning assumptions; transfer those assumptions manually into Power / Design or Experiment Design. Neither tool imports this simulation database, and neither exports the simulation settings grid.
records.translation: Python 스윕 API로 명시한 스크린 설계 가정을 탐색하세요. 조합을 전개하고, 프로세스 풀에서 시뮬레이션을 실행하며, 합성 요약 통계를 씁니다. 반환값은 None입니다. 실행 전에 작고 명시적인 max_workers 값과 범위가 제한된 매개변수 격자를 설정하세요. 출력은 실험적 회귀를 위한 측정값이나 바코드 개수를 대체하지 않습니다. 결과는 가정을 기록한 채 계획 근거로 사용하세요. 계획 가정을 선택할 때 합성 요약을 검토하고, 그 가정을 Power / Design 또는 Experiment Design에 수동으로 옮기세요. 두 도구 모두 이 시뮬레이션 데이터베이스를 가져오지 않으며, 시뮬레이션 설정 격자를 내보내지도 않습니다.

records.key: Use the actual measured feature definitions and units.
records.source: Use the actual measured feature definitions and units.
records.translation: 실제 측정된 특징 정의와 단위를 사용하세요.

records.key: Use the converted layout and preserve source identity mappings.
records.source: Use the converted layout and preserve source identity mappings.
records.translation: 변환된 레이아웃을 사용하고 원본 식별 매핑을 보존하세요.

records.key: Use the experimental layout to define sampling assumptions, then revise the design.
records.source: Use the experimental layout to define sampling assumptions, then revise the design.
records.translation: 실험 레이아웃으로 샘플링 가정을 정의한 다음 설계를 수정하세요.

records.key: Use the matching held-out predictions and split metadata.
records.source: Use the matching held-out predictions and split metadata.
records.translation: 일치하는 보류 예측과 분할 메타데이터를 사용하세요.

records.key: Use the same project and the correct image/mask channel indices.
records.source: Use the same project and the correct image/mask channel indices.
records.translation: 같은 프로젝트와 올바른 이미지/마스크 채널 인덱스를 사용하세요.

records.key: Use the time-series project with stable frame/object identities.
records.source: Use the time-series project with stable frame/object identities.
records.translation: 안정적인 프레임/객체 식별자가 있는 시계열 프로젝트를 사용하세요.

records.key: Vacuole {vacuole}; host {host}; parasites {count}.
records.source: Vacuole {vacuole}; host {host}; parasites {count}.
records.translation: 공포 {vacuole}; 숙주 {host}; 기생충 {count}.

records.key: Validate and execute module jobs in dependency order. Each job writes its own module outputs and log.
records.source: Validate and execute module jobs in dependency order. Each job writes its own module outputs and log.
records.translation: 모듈 작업을 검증하고 의존 순서대로 실행합니다. 각 작업은 자체 모듈 출력과 로그를 씁니다.

records.key: What fraction of full size the background is measured at. The surface is then scaled back up and subtracted from the full-size image, so only the ESTIMATE is smaller. On one 1,994 px field a rolling ball at radius 50 takes 14.5 s at 1.00 and about 1 s at 0.50. 1.00 is scikit-image's own answer exactly, for when you want it and will wait; lower it further on a very large field, and raise it if the surface is missing illumination that changes over a short distance.
records.source: What fraction of full size the background is measured at. The surface is then scaled back up and subtracted from the full-size image, so only the ESTIMATE is smaller. On one 1,994 px field a rolling ball at radius 50 takes 14.5 s at 1.00 and about 1 s at 0.50. 1.00 is scikit-image's own answer exactly, for when you want it and will wait; lower it further on a very large field, and raise it if the surface is missing illumination that changes over a short distance.
records.translation: 배경을 측정할 크기를 전체 크기의 비율로 정합니다. 그런 다음 표면을 원래 크기로 되돌려 전체 크기 이미지에서 빼므로, 작아지는 것은 추정(ESTIMATE)뿐입니다. 1,994 px 시야 하나에서 반지름 50의 롤링 볼은 1.00에서 14.5초, 0.50에서 약 1초가 걸립니다. 1.00은 scikit-image 자체의 결과와 정확히 같으므로 그 결과를 원하고 기다릴 수 있을 때 사용하세요. 아주 큰 시야에서는 값을 더 줄이고, 짧은 거리에서 변하는 조명을 표면이 놓치면 값을 키우세요.

records.key: What the fields are filed under in the measurements database. These images did not come from a plate, so this names where they did come from rather than claiming a plate that was never run. Every row becomes one field of well A01 unless you change its well below.
records.source: What the fields are filed under in the measurements database. These images did not come from a plate, so this names where they did come from rather than claiming a plate that was never run. Every row becomes one field of well A01 unless you change its well below.
records.translation: 측정 데이터베이스에서 시야가 분류되는 이름입니다. 이 이미지들은 플레이트에서 온 것이 아니므로, 실행된 적 없는 플레이트를 주장하지 않고 실제 출처를 적습니다. 아래에서 웰을 바꾸지 않으면 모든 행은 웰 A01의 시야 하나가 됩니다.

records.key: When on, the run measures only the images ticked OK and saved here.
records.source: When on, the run measures only the images ticked OK and saved here.
records.translation: 켜면 여기서 OK로 체크하고 저장한 이미지만 실행에서 측정합니다.

records.key: When save=True, src/masks/<image-name>.tif contains integer labels. The call returns None and does not produce merged arrays or measurements.db.
records.source: When save=True, src/masks/<image-name>.tif contains integer labels. The call returns None and does not produce merged arrays or measurements.db.
records.translation: save=True이면 src/masks/<image-name>.tif 파일에 정수 레이블이 저장됩니다. 호출은 None을 반환하며 병합 배열이나 measurements.db 파일을 만들지 않습니다.

records.key: Where the network's output is cut. Lower it to recover faint branches along with false positives; raise it to keep only confident pixels, which tends to break weak connections.
records.source: Where the network's output is cut. Lower it to recover faint branches along with false positives; raise it to keep only confident pixels, which tends to break weak connections.
records.translation: 네트워크 출력을 자르는 위치입니다. 낮추면 흐린 가지를 되찾지만 위양성도 함께 늘고, 높이면 확실한 픽셀만 남지만 약한 연결이 끊기기 쉽습니다.

records.key: Which global threshold provides the floor, when the rule above is a threshold algorithm's level. The same algorithms the Method box offers on their own.
records.source: Which global threshold provides the floor, when the rule above is a threshold algorithm's level. The same algorithms the Method box offers on their own.
records.translation: 위의 규칙이 임계값 알고리즘의 수준일 때, 하한을 제공하는 전역 임계값입니다. 방법 상자에서 단독으로 제공하는 것과 같은 알고리즘입니다.

records.key: Which object class to embed. It picks the label column in png_list and the mask plane a streamed crop is cut by, so asking for nuclei out of a cell crop table returns nothing rather than returning cells.
records.source: Which object class to embed. It picks the label column in png_list and the mask plane a streamed crop is cut by, so asking for nuclei out of a cell crop table returns nothing rather than returning cells.
